# Senior Director - EMEA Startup Business Development

London, England

CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AITM. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

## **What You’ll Do**

The EMEA Startup Business Development organisation will help make CoreWeave the preferred platform for the next generation of AI-native companies. The team will build relationships and programmes across the institutions that create, fund and accelerate startups, then convert that ecosystem position into qualified opportunities and practical advantage for CoreWeave’s country field teams.

## **About the Role**

The Senior Director, Startup Business Development – EMEA will report to the Vice President and Managing Director, EMEA and lead the development of CoreWeave’s startup and venture capital business across the region.

This is a business development overlay role. Country sales teams will retain account ownership, opportunity management and revenue responsibility across the Startup, Digital Native and Enterprise segments. You will build the relationships, propositions, programmes, market intelligence and operating mechanisms that help those teams identify the right companies earlier, engage them before platform decisions are established and win them onto CoreWeave.

You will build and lead a team spanning priority geographies and regional programmes. Initial focus will include the United Kingdom, France, Germany, the Nordics, Benelux and Israel.

## **In This Role, You Will**

* Define and execute CoreWeave’s EMEA startup business development strategy, operating plan and investment priorities.
* Build a systematic view of the regional startup opportunity, identifying the markets, investor portfolios, technology categories and companies most likely to become significant consumers of AI infrastructure.
* Establish clear criteria for prioritising startups based on technical ambition, compute intensity, funding trajectory, workload timing, leadership quality and strategic value.
* Build senior relationships with venture capital firms, seed and growth investors, accelerators, universities, research laboratories and founder communities.
* Develop strategic engagement plans for priority ecosystem organisations and create repeatable mechanisms for portfolio introductions, founder support, technical engagement and market intelligence.
* Position CoreWeave as the preferred AI infrastructure and developer platform for companies with meaningful training, fine-tuning, inference and applied-intelligence requirements.
* Engage founders, CTOs, researchers and investors before infrastructure architectures and platform relationships are firmly established.
* Create qualified opportunities and introductions for country Startup and Digital Native field teams, connecting high-potential companies rapidly to the right sellers, technical resources and executive sponsors.
* Partner with country sales leaders to define target companies, ecosystem priorities and engagement strategies while maintaining clear account ownership.
* Coordinate strategically important opportunities across Sales, Field Engineering, Product, Engineering, Capacity, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Customer Success.
* Establish clear programme eligibility, investment and graduation criteria, ensuring activity is focused on durable platform adoption and commercial potential.
* Act as the regional voice of the startup ecosystem inside CoreWeave, translating market insight into recommendations for Product, Engineering, Capacity, Marketing and commercial leadership.
* Build, lead and develop a high-performing EMEA Startup Business Development team with complementary programme and geographic coverage.
* Establish a rigorous operating cadence and scorecard covering ecosystem coverage, target-company engagement, field acceptance, sourced and influenced pipeline, technical activation, consumption and downstream commercial impact.

## **Objectives**

During the first 12 months, you will:

* Define the EMEA startup business development strategy, operating plan and investment priorities.
* Develop and launch CoreWeave’s proposition for AI startups at different stages of formation and growth.
* Design and launch the initial portfolio of regional startup and venture ecosystem programmes.
* Define the organisation, hire the initial team and establish coverage across priority programmes and geographies.
* Identify, segment and onboard the venture capital firms, accelerators, universities and research organisations most relevant to CoreWeave.
* Establish senior relationships and strategic engagement plans with priority ecosystem partners.
* Create mechanisms for portfolio introductions, technical engagement, founder support and joint planning.
* Build and maintain a prioritised target list of high-potential AI startups and research spinouts.
* Map priority investor portfolios against CoreWeave’s ideal startup profile and connect qualified companies to the appropriate country sales teams.
* Establish clear ways of working with country field sales teams, including qualification, routing, account assignment, handoff, executive sponsorship and attribution.
* Establish effective operating mechanisms with Product, Engineering, Field Engineering, Marketing, Capacity, Finance, Legal and other supporting groups.
* Implement the business review cadence, measurement framework and attribution model required to assess ecosystem and field impact.

## **Who You Are**

* 15+ years of experience in business development, sales, partnerships, startup go-to-market or venture ecosystem leadership within cloud infrastructure, enterprise technology, AI or another complex technology environment.
* Significant leadership experience building and operating startup, venture capital or ecosystem programmes across multiple EMEA markets.
* A proven record of converting ecosystem relationships into qualified opportunities, technical adoption, pipeline, consumption and commercial growth.
* Demonstrated experience developing senior relationships with venture capital firms, accelerators, universities, research organisations, founders, CTOs and technology executives.
* Experience working with country sales organisations to create demand and accelerate customer acquisition without displacing account ownership.
* Strong understanding of the startup lifecycle, from formation and seed funding through venture growth and scaled commercial operation.
* Experience identifying promising companies early and assessing their technical ambition, infrastructure needs, funding trajectory and long-term potential.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, AI platforms, developer tooling and the requirements of AI-native companies.
* Demonstrated ability to build structured programmes, operating mechanisms and performance measures that scale beyond personal relationships.
* Experience aligning Sales, Field Engineering, Product, Marketing, Finance, Legal and executive stakeholders around shared opportunities.
* Strong analytical and operational capability, including market segmentation, portfolio analysis, opportunity attribution and executive business reviews.
* Experience building, hiring, coaching and developing high-performing business development or ecosystem teams.
* A record of operating successfully across EMEA markets and cultures, with the ability to travel regularly.

## **Preferred**

* Leadership experience within the startup organisation of a major hyperscale cloud provider, AI platform company or global infrastructure technology business.
* Direct experience building or scaling a regional startup business measured through customer acquisition, workload adoption, consumption and revenue.
* Experience designing the operating model between a regional startup business development organisation and country-based sales teams.
* Established senior relationships across the EMEA venture capital and AI startup ecosystem.
* Experience working with compute-intensive AI companies across training, fine-tuning, inference, applied AI or AI platform development.
* Experience creating startup programmes or technical adoption mechanisms that helped companies progress from experimentation to scaled production workloads.
* Experience influencing product, capacity and go-to-market decisions using insight from founders, investors and startups.
* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

We will also consider an exceptional senior venture ecosystem builder who has strong credibility with EMEA investors and founders, can identify high-potential technical companies early and has translated ecosystem access into measurable commercial outcomes for a technology platform.

Experience focused primarily on events, sponsorships, brand awareness or community activity will not, by itself, be sufficient.

## **Wondering If You’re a Good Fit?**

We believe in investing in our people and value candidates who bring different experiences, even if they do not meet every requirement.

* You have built a startup business or ecosystem and understand that credibility must ultimately produce customer and field outcomes.
* You can move comfortably between a venture capital partner, a technical founder, a country sales leader and an internal product executive.
* You combine a strong external network with the discipline to build repeatable systems.
* You recognise promising companies early and make clear recommendations about where CoreWeave should invest time and resources.
* You measure success through the quality of companies won, workloads activated and value created for field teams, not activity alone.
* You operate with urgency, commercial judgement, curiosity and a strong bias toward execution.

## **Why CoreWeave?**

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun and move fast. We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth, we’re not afraid of a little chaos and we’re constantly learning.

Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

* Be Curious at Your Core
* Act Like an Owner
* Empower Employees
* Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
* Achieve More Together

We support an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking, and foster an environment that encourages collaboration and innovative solutions to complex problems. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, with the opportunity to help shape CoreWeave’s future.

## **Compensation**

The compensation package consists of a competitive base salary, performance-based annual bonus, equity awards and CoreWeave’s applicable benefits package.

*To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.*

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Inference team, you will operate as a technical leader across multiple teams and services, driving architecture, performance, and reliability for CoreWeave’s Kubernetes-native inference platform. * Experienced in owning system-wide SLIs/SLOs, capacity planning, autoscaling strategies, and mentoring senior and mid-level engineers.

Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. **About the Role:**

As the Executive Strategist, UK Public Sector, you will advise current and future government customers and deliver thought leadership while supporting the growth of CrowdStrike's strategic partnerships across UK government. You will be joining a team dedicated to making a difference in national security by protecting critical government infrastructure and services against the most advanced nation-state and criminal adversaries in the world.

The CrowdStrike Executive Strategist Team provides executive liaison support, engaging current and potential government clients externally, while interacting internally with teams across the company including Sales, Product, Marketing, Government Affairs, Legal and more. This role is specifically focused on the UK public sector, including central government departments, devolved administrations, defence and intelligence communities, NHS, policing, and local government.

As CrowdStrike's Executive Strategist for UK Public Sector, you will be responsible for sharing the company's capabilities, strategic vision and cybersecurity strategy, working closely with the UK Public Sector sales team, Government Affairs, marketing, the CTO's Office, and Product Managers on a regular basis. You will also work closely with CrowdStrike's policy, legal and corporate affairs, and public relations teams to position CrowdStrike as a strategic partner to UK government.

This role reports to the Director, UK Public Sector, with a dotted line to the VP of the Executive Strategists Team. With your extensive UK public sector cybersecurity background and your ability to think and operate at a strategic level, you will drive public sector vision and strategy while providing support on strategic industry events and speaking engagements across the United Kingdom.

This position requires UK citizenship and is based in the United Kingdom, with eligibility for Security Clearance as required. 

**What You'll Do:**

**Are You Our Executive Strategist?**

• Are you mission led; committed to protecting the UK's national security, critical infrastructure, and public services from advanced cyber threats?

• Are you self-motivated and looking for an opportunity to advance government cybersecurity programs and sector wide cyber strategy development?

• Do you crave new and innovative work that actually matters to the nation and its citizens?

• Do you have experience leading security teams in large UK public sector organisations (central government, NHS, defence, intelligence, policing, or equivalent)?

• Are you capable of articulating complex security problems through easy-to-understand solutions, drawing upon your lived experience as a practitioner?

• Do you love working around like-minded, smart people who you can learn from and mentor on a daily basis?

• Do you have established relationships within the UK public sector CISO and security leadership community?

**Strategic Advisory & Customer Engagement:**

• Serve as an advisor to UK public sector CISOs and security leaders, providing practitioner-level guidance on strategic planning initiatives, the current threat landscape, and proactive initiatives to stay ahead of adversaries

• Establish and maintain active relationships with key customers and decision-makers across UK central government departments.

• Conduct executive briefings with current and prospective government clients, providing independent, non-commercial cybersecurity modernisation guidance and strategic advisory

• Facilitate peer-to-peer engagement between UK public sector security leaders, creating forums for knowledge sharing and best practice exchange

• Support strategic partnership development with key government bodies aligned to the Government Cyber Action Plan

**Thought Leadership & Industry Engagement:**

• Speak at national and regional industry events, including CyberUK, government cyber forums, defence and security conferences, and public sector technology events

• Host customer roundtables and advisory sessions, sharing industry strategies, threat intelligence, and facilitating feedback opportunities for product enhancements relevant to UK government requirements

• Produce high-quality written content including blog posts, articles, white papers, and government consultation responses that establish CrowdStrike as a thought leader in UK public sector cybersecurity

• Represent CrowdStrike at parliamentary cyber security groups, industry working groups, and public-private partnership forums

• Deliver threat landscape briefings specific to UK government threats, including nation-state activity, ransomware targeting public services, and supply chain risks

**Internal Collaboration & Enablement:**

• Advise the company and sales teams on the most effective approaches to UK public sector engagement, procurement frameworks, and security assurance requirements.

• Coach, train and mentor UK Public Sector sales teams, sales engineers, and partners on public sector CISO priorities, government procurement processes, and effective engagement strategies.

• Develop strategic engagement plans with sales teams for major government opportunities, providing practitioner insight on stakeholder mapping, technical validation approaches, and competitive positioning

• Collaborate closely with Government Affairs to understand policy-level relationships.

• Work with Product and Engineering teams to translate UK government requirements (data sovereignty, supply chain security, certification needs) into product roadmap priorities

**Strategic Partnership & Market Intelligence**:

• Support CrowdStrike's strategic partnerships with NCSC, contributing practitioner expertise to joint initiatives, threat intelligence sharing, and industry collaboration programs

• Maintain in-depth knowledge of the UK cybersecurity landscape, including government cyber strategy, regulatory developments (NIS2, DORA, Cyber Security and Resilience Bill), competitive positioning, and emerging threats to public sector

• Provide market intelligence on UK public sector priorities, budget cycles, procurement trends, and competitor activity to inform CrowdStrike's UK strategy

• Support the Executive Briefing Program for UK government customers, either virtually or at CrowdStrike facilities

**What You'll Need:**

**Essential Qualifications**

**Security Leadership Experience:**

• Extensive track record in cybersecurity, with experience of senior leadership roles in UK public sector organisations

• Deep understanding of UK government cyber security requirements, including NCSC guidance, Government Security Classifications, protective monitoring, and security assurance frameworks

**Technical & Strategic Competency:**

• Broad information security competency across strategy, governance, risk management, architecture, and operations

• Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

• Deep technical knowledge of modern cybersecurity technologies including endpoint security, XDR/EDR, cloud security, identity and access management, SIEM/log management, incident response, and threat intelligence

• Experience with security transformation programs, including Zero Trust architecture, cloud migration security, legacy estate modernisation, and security operating model design

• Understanding of threat landscape relevant to UK government, including nation-state actors (Russia, China, Iran, North Korea), ransomware groups, and insider threats

**UK Public Sector Expertise:**

• Established network within UK public sector CISO and security leadership community, with ability to activate peer relationships and references

• Deep understanding of UK government procurement frameworks and security assurance processes 

• Experience navigating UK government structures, including departmental relationships, cross-government initiatives, and public-private partnerships

• Knowledge of UK cyber policy landscape, including National Cyber Strategy, Government Cyber Action Plan, defence cyber strategy, and relevant legislation

**Communication & Influence:**

• Exceptional communication skills, with ability to articulate complex security concepts to diverse audiences from technical practitioners to ministerial-level stakeholders

• Proven thought leadership, including speaking at industry conferences, published articles/blogs, participation in industry working groups, or media engagement

• Ability to operate with high independence, leading cross-functional efforts and influencing senior internal and external stakeholders

• Strategic thinking capability, translating technical security challenges into business outcomes and strategic recommendations

**Personal Attributes:**

• Practitioner credibility: Ability to engage as peer with public sector CISOs, demonstrating lived experience and battle scars

• Non-commercial advisory approach: Comfortable providing objective, strategic guidance without sales pressure

• Collaborative mindset: Works effectively with sales teams, Government Affairs, and cross-functional stakeholders

• Passion for public service: Genuine commitment to protecting UK national security and public services

• Continuous learner: Stays current on evolving threats, technologies, and government priorities

**Desirable Qualifications:**

• Former CISO or Deputy CISO from major UK government department, NHS organisation, MOD, intelligence community, or national policing

• NCSC engagement experience, including participation in NCSC working groups, CyberUK speaking, or NCSC certification processes

• Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or equivalent (desirable but not essential given practitioner experience requirement)

• Experience with incident response in government context, including major cyber incidents or nation-state attacks

• Existing relationships with key government stakeholders

• Published thought leadership on UK public sector cybersecurity challenges

**Working Arrangements**:

• Location: UK-based, London preferred (hybrid working available)

• Travel: Regular travel within UK required (approximately 30-40%), including to customer sites, government facilities, and industry events

• Flexibility: Role requires flexibility to attend government meetings, industry events, and customer engagements as needed

• Security: Work may involve access to government facilities requiring security clearance and adherence to government security protocols

# Relationship Director - Business Banking & Liquidity

## Join Cynergy Bank and help grow our Business Banking & Liquidity franchise. Build meaningful client relationships, drive deposit growth, and shape the future of Human Digital Banking.

*Drive deposit growth. Build strategic client relationships. Shape the future of Human Digital Banking.*

**Salary: £70,000 - £90,000 + Bonus + Benefits**

*The level and salary offered will reflect your skills, experience and career stage. We welcome applications from both experienced Relationship Directors and individuals looking to take the next step in their relationship management career.*

At Cynergy Bank, we call it **Human Digital Banking** by combining the agility of a fintech with the trust of a traditional bank. We are looking for an experienced and ambitious Relationship Director to play a key role in growing our liquidity and deposit franchise, building strategic client relationships, and supporting the Bank's funding ambitions.

This is an opportunity to join an award-winning challenger bank where your expertise, network and ideas can have a direct and visible impact on business performance.

**Why Join Us?**

We know the best people want more than just a job. At Cynergy, you will find:

* **Impact** – Play a key role in delivering deposit growth and supporting the Bank's strategic funding objectives.
* **Influence** – Work closely with senior leadership and contribute to the development of our business banking and liquidity proposition.
* **Growth** – Expand your network and develop relationships across a broad range of clients and industries.
* **Flexibility** – Hybrid working with 3 days in the office and 2 days from home.
* **Culture** – An entrepreneurial, collaborative environment where your ideas matter and decision-making is fast.
* **Rewards** – Competitive salary, annual bonus and a comprehensive benefits package designed around you.

**Why This Opportunity Is Different**

At Cynergy Bank, you'll have the opportunity to see the bigger picture.

Unlike many larger organisations, you'll gain exposure to the full client lifecycle, work closely with senior decision-makers and have the freedom to make a meaningful impact. Whether you're an experienced Relationship Director or a high-performing relationship manager looking to step up, you'll be supported to grow, develop and realise your potential.

We're looking for people who want to build relationships, challenge convention, contribute ideas and help shape the future of Human Digital Banking.

**The Role**

This is a strategic relationship management and business development role focused on growing deposit balances and building long-term client relationships.

You will use your commercial expertise and market knowledge to identify opportunities, attract new business, and deliver solutions that help clients meet their liquidity and cash management needs.

**In this role, you will:**

* Develop and execute strategies to attract stable, low-cost deposits.
* Build and grow a portfolio of liquidity and deposit relationships.
* Drive acquisition of Business Current Accounts and Business Savings Accounts.
* Identify new business opportunities across target sectors and markets.
* Develop trusted relationships with clients, understanding their cash management and treasury requirements.
* Work closely with colleagues across the Bank to deliver excellent client outcomes.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activity and performance metrics to identify growth opportunities.
* Represent Cynergy Bank at industry events, networking opportunities and client meetings.
* Contribute to the ongoing development of the Bank's transactional banking and liquidity offering.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Growth in deposit balances and liquidity relationships.
* Acquisition of new Business Current Account and Savings clients.
* Development of a strong referral and intermediary network.
* Delivery against agreed commercial and relationship KPIs.
* Contribution to the Bank's broader funding and growth strategy.

**What You Will Bring**

We recognise that great talent comes from different backgrounds and career journeys. Whether you are already operating as a Relationship Director or are a high-performing relationship manager ready for your next step, we'd love to hear from you.

We're particularly interested in individuals who:

* Have a strong track record of building and growing client relationships within banking or financial services.
* Understand deposits, cash management, liquidity solutions, transaction banking or broader business banking products.
* Enjoy developing new business opportunities and building trusted client partnerships.
* Are commercially minded and motivated by delivering results.
* Bring curiosity, ambition and a desire to continue learning and growing.
* Want the opportunity to broaden their experience and gain exposure to the wider commercial strategy of a growing bank.
* Thrive in a relationship-led, entrepreneurial and inclusive environment.

We value potential as much as experience and are committed to building diverse teams. If you're excited by this opportunity but don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

**How We Will Support You**

At Cynergy Bank, we are committed to your wellbeing and success. We know everyone's needs are different, so our benefits are designed to support you at every stage of your career and life.

Here's a snapshot of what we offer:

* Competitive salary and performance-related bonus.
* **28 days' annual leave**, with the option to buy up to 10 additional days.
* **An extra day off to celebrate your birthday.**
* **Award-winning pension scheme** with Aegon (4% employee contribution and 5% employer contribution).
* **Private medical insurance with Bupa**, or a Health Cash Plan if preferred.
* Life assurance and income protection.
* Hybrid working (3 days in the office, 2 days from home).
* **Dress for Your Day** policy, giving you flexibility in how you work and present yourself.
* Training, development and career progression opportunities.

Plus, a range of additional benefits including lifestyle discounts, recognition awards and volunteering initiatives, all designed to help you thrive both professionally and personally.

**Who Are We?**

Cynergy Bank is the UK's human digital bank, combining personal service with smart technology to help ambitious businesses and individuals achieve their goals.

Since 2018, we have lent over £4bn to scaling businesses and partnered with leading firms to deliver the future of banking. Named **Bank of the Year 2025** by **MoneyAge**, we are recognised for our commitment to customers, innovation and tailored solutions.

Our values shape everything we do:

**Putting the Customer First | Risk Front and Centre | Opportunity, Empowerment and Innovation | United Team, Inclusive and Diverse | Doing the Right Thing**

These principles guide our decisions, drive our culture and help us deliver the best outcomes for our customers and colleagues.

Learn more about us at **cynergybank.co.uk/about-us**

**Right to Work**

Please note that Cynergy Bank is unable to sponsor employment visas for this position. Applicants must have an existing and ongoing right to work in the UK without requiring sponsorship, now or in the future.

**A Few Things to Know**

This advert covers the main responsibilities and requirements of the role. A full job description will be shared with shortlisted candidates. If you do not meet every requirement, we would still encourage you to apply. We value potential as much as experience.

At Cynergy Bank, we use **anonymous screening** at the first stage of recruitment to ensure every application is assessed fairly and based on skills and experience alone.

**If you're passionate about building client relationships, growing deposit portfolios and helping shape the future of business banking, we'd love to hear from you.**

**Apply now and help shape the future of Human Digital Banking at Cynergy Bank.**

# Paralegal - Professional Indemnity

DAC Beachcroft's Professional and Commercial Risk team is one of the leading defendant professional indemnity practices in the UK, acting on behalf of insurers and professionals across a broad range of sectors.  
  
We have an opportunity for a Paralegal to join a specialist professional indemnity team in Manchester, supporting a delegated authority scheme focused exclusively on claims against law firms. Acting on behalf of leading insurers, the team investigates and resolves allegations of professional negligence made against solicitors and law firms, handling matters from initial notification through to resolution.  
  
This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop technical, commercial and client-handling skills. You'll be given responsibility from an early stage, managing your own caseload while working closely with experienced lawyers and insurer clients. Initially, you will support a specialist delegated authority scheme handling professional indemnity claims against law firms, gaining exposure to a wide variety of issues and developing strong claims-handling and investigative skills. Following this period, there will be an opportunity to broaden your experience within the wider Professional and Commercial Risk team, working across a broader range of professional indemnity and litigation matters.

## Key Responsibilities

You will be responsible for handling a varied caseload of pre-litigation professional indemnity matters on behalf of insurer clients, investigating allegations made against law firms and assisting in the resolution of disputes.  
  
This is a client-facing role with significant responsibility and regular interaction with both insurers and insured law firms. You will develop experience in investigating claims, assessing liability and drafting responses, while building relationships with key client contacts.  
  
Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Managing a caseload of delegated authority professional indemnity matters under appropriate supervision.
* Investigating allegations of professional negligence made against solicitors and law firms.
* Reviewing case documentation and identifying key legal, factual and procedural issues.
* Drafting correspondence, responses to complaints and liability position letters.
* Liaising with insurer clients, insured law firms and other stakeholders on a day-to-day basis.
* Building and maintaining strong client relationships, becoming a trusted point of contact for allocated law firms.
* Conducting legal research and preparing case summaries and internal reports.

## Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

We are interested in hearing from candidates who can demonstrate:

* Previous experience working in a legal environment, ideally within professional indemnity, insurance litigation or dispute resolution.
* Strong investigative and analytical skills, with the ability to identify key issues and assess risk.
* Excellent written communication skills, with confidence drafting professional correspondence.

Previous experience in any of the following areas would be advantageous, but is not essential:

* Professional indemnity claims.
* Claims against solicitors or law firms.
* Insurance litigation.
* Defendant litigation.
* Dispute resolution.
* Regulatory or complaints handling work.
* Professional Negligence

## Why Join Us?

This role offers a fantastic opportunity to develop your career within a specialist area of law while gaining significant responsibility and client exposure from day one.

* Growth and prosperity
* Housing and homelessness

You will lead on gathering and translating business requirements, work collaboratively with technical teams to develop effective BI solutions, and provide analysis and insights that help improve outcomes for residents and support organisational priorities. A key focus of the role will be supporting the implementation of the new Adult Social Care system by designing and developing reporting solutions, ensuring reporting requirements are captured and delivered, and helping the service transition to new ways of working through high-quality management information and performance reporting.

We are looking for a proactive and analytical professional who is passionate about using data to drive better outcomes and service improvement. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills are essential, as you will be working closely with operational services, senior leaders, and technical teams.

Beyond strong technical and analytical skills, we are seeking someone who can think creatively, challenge traditional approaches, and develop innovative solutions to complex business problems. At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact.

Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,000 individuals, representing more than 60 different nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow rapidly!

# Data Enablement Officer

Help shape how Efficio uses data responsibly, securely and effectively.

We are looking for a Data Enablement Officer to establish and lead Efficio’s data governance framework, helping us protect client data while enabling its responsible use across our services, analytics, products and AI capabilities.

This is a highly visible role at the intersection of data, technology, AI, risk and client delivery. You will work across the business to turn complex contractual, regulatory, privacy and security requirements into practical guidance that enables teams to innovate with confidence.

Initially, the role will have a strong advisory and enablement focus: helping teams understand client requirements, assess new uses of data and make proportionate, risk-based decisions. As our governance model matures, the role is expected to take greater ownership of the framework and delegated authority for lower-risk decisions.

## What you'll be doing

### Establish our data governance framework

You will assess our current data-handling practices and develop a practical, scalable governance framework covering the lifecycle of client data – from collection and classification through to access, use, sharing, storage, retention and secure deletion.

You will develop and maintain policies and standards covering areas including:

* Client data handling and classification
* Data reuse and fair usage
* Use of client data within Efficio products
* Use of data with AI tools, including third-party and self-hosted solutions
* Data access and security
* Retention, archiving and secure disposal
* Anonymisation and aggregation
* Third-party data sharing
* Policy exceptions and escalation

You will also help establish and maintain our information asset inventories, data flows and AI asset registers.

### Enable responsible use of data and AI

A key part of the role will be helping teams determine what we can do with data, under what conditions, and with what safeguards.

You will establish a consistent approach for assessing new and changing data use cases, considering factors such as:

* Why the data was originally obtained
* Client and contractual restrictions
* Data sensitivity and classification
* The proposed use and intended recipients
* Security and access controls
* Retention requirements
* Legal, client and reputational considerations

For AI use cases, you will help define which activities are permitted, restricted, require additional review or are prohibited. This will include the use of prompts, uploaded files and connected data sources, as well as expectations around human oversight, output validation and accountability.

### Govern products, platforms and technology

You will define the conditions under which client data can be stored or processed using Efficio products, SaaS platforms, cloud services and AI tools.

Working closely with Technology, Information Security, Legal and Privacy teams, you will assess areas including:

* Data residency and international transfers
* Encryption, access controls and logging
* Supplier and subcontractor access
* Data retention, backups and deletion
* Exit and data-export arrangements
* Use of customer data for AI model training, product improvement or other secondary purposes

You will help ensure that unapproved platforms are not used for client data without appropriate assessment and documented approval.

### Support new solutions and innovation

You will work alongside teams designing and deploying new data, software, analytics and AI solutions, providing governance input from an early stage.

Ahead of launch, you will help confirm that the appropriate governance, legal, privacy and security reviews have taken place and that material risks have been appropriately addressed.

Where issues remain, you will recommend practical remediation, escalation or, where necessary, a delay to rollout. Acceptance of significant residual risk will remain with the appropriate executive or governance committee.

### Build governance that works in practice

This role isn't simply about writing policies. We want to create a governance model that teams can understand and use.

You will help develop:

* A clear data governance operating model and decision-rights framework
* Practical data, AI, security, reuse and retention policies
* Data and AI use-case assessment processes
* Risk-classification and escalation models
* Policy exception processes and decision registers
* Product and AI platform assessment standards
* Solution launch-readiness checklists
* Training, guidance and supporting materials
* Governance reporting for senior leadership and relevant committees

You will coordinate, advise and constructively challenge stakeholders across the organisation while recognising that responsibility for managing data risk is shared across business owners, data owners, Legal and Privacy, Information Security, Technology and senior governance forums.

## Client engagement

This will also be an important client-facing role.

You will participate in client discussions where required, confidently explaining Efficio's approach to data governance, security and responsible data use.

You should be comfortable responding to questions about how client data is accessed, used, stored, shared, retained and protected, translating technical or governance concepts into clear, credible explanations for different audiences.

## What we're looking for

We are looking for someone with experience across one or more of the following areas:

* Data governance or data management
* Data privacy
* Information security
* Technology or operational risk
* AI governance or responsible AI

You will also bring a practical understanding of modern technology environments, including SaaS, cloud, analytics and AI platforms.

You'll be someone who can operate comfortably between policy and practice – able to understand complex requirements while recognising the commercial and operational realities of a consulting and technology-enabled business.

In particular, you will be able to:

* Translate complex regulatory, contractual and security requirements into practical business guidance
* Apply proportionate, risk-based judgement rather than relying on a purely rules-based approach
* Influence and challenge senior stakeholders constructively
* Work effectively across Technology, Security, Legal, Privacy and business teams
* Balance commercial objectives and innovation with appropriate governance
* Communicate confidently with clients and senior internal stakeholders
* Build processes and frameworks that are robust without creating unnecessary bureaucracy
* Navigate emerging areas where the answer may not always be immediately clear

## What success looks like

Success in this role will mean that teams understand how to use data appropriately rather than simply being told what they cannot do.

We will look at measures including adoption of priority policies, review turnaround times, reduction in unapproved tool usage, effective management of exceptions, quality of governance reporting, stakeholder feedback and a reduction in recurring governance issues.

Ultimately, the role will be judged on its ability to achieve both sides of our data ambition: protecting our clients and Efficio while enabling appropriate, secure and innovative use of data and AI.

**Quality Assurance**

You’ll initially take ownership of a small engineering team, working closely with product and other teams to decide what to build and get it shipped.

Six months in, your team should trust you, people outside the team should know where things stand, and the team should be delivering what it says it will.

* Own the engineering direction, delivery and health of a small team of senior product engineers.

* Give engineers regular feedback, run useful 1:1s and performance reviews, and actively help them grow in their careers.
* Notice what’s slowing the team down and fix it, surface problems early and keep the rest of the company clear on what’s happening.
* Own hiring for your team and play an active role in helping Junction grow.

## Requirements

* You’ve led and directly managed experienced software engineers.
* You’ve stayed technically involved while managing
* You’ve owned a team’s delivery, not just its people management.
* You can give useful technical feedback and make sound calls on engineering trade-offs.
* You’ve worked with product and other teams to turn customer problems into shipped software.
* You’ve helped engineers develop through direct feedback, coaching and meaningful opportunities to take on more.
* You’ve hired engineers and helped raise the technical or operating standards of a team.

*You don’t need to tick every box to fit in here. If the problems we’re solving genuinely interest you and you know you can contribute, we’d love to talk.*

## Nice to have

Following various acquisitions, we are now the largest Tier 1 Contractor operating in the UK Water / Environment sector with a long-term portfolio trading £500 million a year. As Drinking Water Biased Principal Engineer you will be an important member of the Engineering Design Team and will be required to work with the Discipline Manager(s), Design Team, Design Manager(s) and Design Leads to ensure your discipline design is delivered to highest quality to GT process and in compliance with the BMS and H&S Regulations. This is a technical role, engaged directly on projects, which requires expertise in technical design delivery in the water and wastewater industry. You will be called upon to provide technical expertise and direction on more complex designs. The Principal Engineer can have line management responsibility for senior engineers and others as required.

As well as providing direction and promoting innovation, you will be expected to undertake engineering governance of your discipline design activities, ensuring that design integrates with the other discipline design production activities, providing technical support to the supply chain procurement activities and supporting site activities as required. You will also be expected to support the Discipline Manager for knowledge sharing, training, and development of the discipline engineers, including mentoring and support of early careers.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Ensure technical compliance and excellence on projects. Default approver for design outputs to ensure technical assurance and quality control.
* Seek optimal solutions and drive our teams to produce efficient designs that balance capital and operational cost benefits.
* Assist, or operate as, the Principal Designer Lead in ensuring CDM regulations compliance.
* Ensure design for buildability, safe construction, and operation, working alongside project delivery peers.
* Ensure procedural governance is adhered to.
* Working as part of the Design team to ensure scheme designs adhere to client specifications and standards.
* Working as part of the Design team to ensure full compliance with relevant Health, Safety and Environmental Legislation.
* Technical problem solving throughout the project life cycle (e.g. from concept design through to final construction support), moreover, to ensure that potential issues are identified, mitigated and or safely managed through technical governance and risk and opportunity management.
* Champion of lessons learnt on projects, covering good and bad to feedback to be promoted or avoided on future schemes.
* Line Management of multi-disciplinary Senior Design Engineers.

## **About Gigs**

At Gigs, we're building the operating system for mobile services—a platform that lets tech companies embed global connectivity into their products effortlessly.

Just as Stripe lets any business add a payment button in seconds, Gigs empowers platforms to weave in connectivity—bridging the traditional world of telecom with modern tech. From fintechs launching mobile services to HR platforms offering work phone plans, we automate provisioning and remove telecom complexity.

Our team of around 150 people across the US and Europe, backed by nearly $100 million in funding from Ribbit Capital, Google, and Y Combinator. As one of the fastest-growing tech companies, bringing together early-stage engineers, product builders, and business athletes from companies like Stripe, Airbnb, and Shopify. We’re tackling deep technical and regulatory challenges to make connectivity truly seamless.

If you’re driven by curiosity, creativity, and the chance to shape the future of telecom, we’d love to hear from you.

## **Things We Care About**

We are building in a highly complex space and tackling a massive problem. We want people who lean in when things get hard.

* **Speed.** We move and we ship. We set bold deadlines and treat every week like it matters.
* **Ownership.** If you see something broken, fix it. We don't wait for permission.
* **Customer Obsession**. Our customers' product is our product.
* **Ambiguity.** We're building frontier technology in a complex domain. You'll need sound judgement and good instincts to make decisions without complete information.
* **First principles.** We don't ask how things have been done before. We ask why they were done that way at all.

## The Role

Gigs has built a multi-market, multi-product embedded connectivity business, and we're looking for someone to own the operating system the Growth team runs on. This is a high-leverage, cross-functional role sitting at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution, responsible for making the Growth org faster, smarter, and more cohesive.

You will operate with high autonomy and report to the VP of Growth, while working closely with Finance, Legal, and functional leads across GTM, Customer Success, Implementation, and Marketing.

This role is for someone who thrives in complexity, communicates confidently with senior stakeholders, and uses AI as default leverage to move faster and build better.

**What you will do**

* **Own the operating cadence of Growth.** Run planning cycles, reporting rhythms, and cross-functional coordination across GTM, Customer Success, Implementation, and Marketing, so Growth runs as one function.
* **Build what lets knowledge travel.**Write the playbooks, runbooks, and documentation that take what works in one region and make it work everywhere else. What you build should outlast your direct involvement.
* **Own the data and reporting infrastructure.**Build the systems that tell the Growth team what's working and where to focus next.
* **Lead the AI and tooling stack.**Make sure the team is actually using AI to multiply output.
* **Drive strategic projects end-to-end.**Market expansion, segmentation, GTM playbooks, from framing the problem to shipping the output.
* **Keep the function moving.**Unblock what needs unblocking across a multi-market, multi-product Growth team that's operating faster than its infrastructure can handle.

**What we are looking for**

* **4+ years in a demanding operational environment** — biz ops, strategy & ops, management consulting, or growth ops at a fast-scaling company. You've operated under pressure and know what it feels like to own something that matters
* **You are self-driven and relentlessly proactive.**You don't need someone to hand you a problem definition. You find the problem, form a view, and start moving. We'd rather tell you to slow down than push you to speed up
* **AI is part of your working stack.** You use AI tools daily—for analysis, automation, building internal tooling, accelerating research. You can point to specific things you've built or automated that didn't exist before you made them.
* **You can read the room and the data.** You can translate a data finding into a business decision and communicate it clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
* **You're a generalist who goes deep.** Comfortable moving between a data problem, a process problem, and a strategic framing problem in the same week.
* **High ownership, low ego.**You juggle context across multiple workstreams without dropping threads. You take pride in making complex things work reliably, not in getting credit for it. When something is yours, it gets done.

**Bonus points if**

* You have experience in telecoms, fintech, or B2B SaaS - especially anything touching connectivity or payments.
* You've built or improved internal tooling or automated workflows using AI or no-code tools.
* You've operated across multiple markets or regions and know what it takes to make something work globally, not just in one office.

Salary Range: £85,000 - £110,000  
(The final offer depends on your background, skills, and how you perform through the process. We're open to considering outlier candidates, which may result in an adjustment to the scope and compensation)

## Work At Gigs

At Gigs, we value in-person collaboration. We believe the best ideas, decisions, and relationships are built when teams spend meaningful time together, and our culture is designed around that belief. We support flexibility where it makes sense. Some focused work can be done remotely, and not every role or week looks the same. **You should expect regular time in one of our** **hubs**, as well as occasional travel for team workshops, customer meetings, and **Gigs Republic, our bi-annual company off-site**. GS1 UK is looking for a hybrid UX/UI Designer to provide flexible, project-based support for My Numberbank, our core membership service for managing GS1 identifiers, barcodes, QR codes powered by GS1 and trusted product data. My Numberbank is GS1 UK’s core digital service for members. It enables users to assign and manage GTINs and GLNs, generate compliant barcodes, create QR codes powered by GS1, maintain product data, and share trusted information through services such as Verified by GS1. The next phase of product development will enhance how members manage richer product data, use-case-specific attributes, validation feedback and data exports.

This is not a pure graphic or web design role. It requires a blend of UX thinking service design awareness, product design capability and hands-on UI execution. The designer will need to work collaboratively with GS1 UK product, standards, marketing and technical stakeholders, and with a QWARE UX developer who will implement the agreed designs using the MudBlazor library. Designs should therefore be practical, component-aware and suitable for build within the existing My Numberbank technology approach.

Key design principles

* Show attributes, tabs and guidance only when relevant to the product category and selected use case.
* Keep filtering as a visibility layer so underlying product data is not duplicated or changed unnecessarily.

* Design for future scalability, including additional attributes, new use cases, regulatory requirements and product data services.

* Strong experience in UX/UI, product design or digital product design, ideally in B2B, SaaS, membership services, data platforms or complex form-based journeys.

  user journeys and practical interface designs.

* Journey maps and user flows covering key member tasks, decision points and interaction paths.

This is a new business role at heart. The majority of your pipeline will come from your own outbound activity: researching target federations, leagues and event organisers, identifying the right people to approach and making first contact. You will take those conversations from an initial approach through proposal, pricing and negotiation to a signed contract, and then grow the relationship from there. * Build and maintain a target list of federations, leagues, promoters, broadcasters and event organisers across existing and new sports, and keep it prioritised as the market moves.

* Develop and present business proposals, commercial bids and responses to RFPs and tenders.
* Manage your pipeline and forecasts accurately in the CRM, and revisit dormant or unsuccessful prospects on a planned basis.
* Respond to inbound business development enquiries and qualify them alongside self-generated opportunities.

### **Client and Partner Engagement**

* Establish and nurture relationships with key stakeholders, including federations, leagues, event organisers and broadcasters.
* Navigate long, multi-stakeholder buying processes, including committee approvals, tender cycles and seasonal budget timelines.
* Identify additional competitions, venues, territories and product lines to sell into existing accounts, rather than waiting for renewal conversations.
* Work closely with internal teams to ensure successful execution of contracts and client deliverables.

### **Financial and Commercial Strategy**

* Develop cost sheets, pricing models and financial forecasts for new business opportunities.
* Collaborate with the legal team to draft and negotiate contracts through to close.
* Track and manage contract timelines, renewals and new agreements, opening renewal conversations well ahead of expiry.
* Manage the invoicing schedule for each of your clients.
* Monitor revenue performance and contribute to financial reporting and forecasting.

### **Internal Collaboration and Efficiency**

* Work closely with Commercial Managers across other sports to align business development strategies and share market intelligence and proposal content.
* Develop efficient processes for proposal creation, contract management and revenue tracking.
* Ensure a seamless transition from commercial discussions to operational execution.

## **Qualifications and Experience**

* A track record of winning new business that you sourced yourself, ideally against a revenue or new business target.
* Experience of considered, complex B2B sales with cycles measured in months rather than weeks.
* Experience in business development, sales or commercial strategy within the sports industry, or a comparable technology sector.
* Knowledge of sports technology and the competitive landscape across both emerging and established sports.
* Excellent financial and analytical skills to build cost structures and pricing models.
* Ability to draft and negotiate commercial contracts with support from the legal team.
* Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills.
* Confident use of a CRM to manage pipeline and forecasting.
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, sports management, marketing or a related field, or equivalent commercial experience.

## **Key Skills and Attributes**

* **New Business Focused:** Enjoys opening relationships from cold and takes ownership of generating their own pipeline.
* **Resilient:** Comfortable with the pace and response rates of outbound work, and persistent without being pushy.
* **Strategic Mindset:** Chooses targets carefully and can explain why a sport or account is worth pursuing.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Understands market trends, financial models and business drivers.
* **Client-Focused:** Strong relationship-building skills with a customer-centric approach.
* **Detail-Oriented:** Manages multiple opportunities, contracts and financial details without letting follow-ups slip.
* **Collaborative:** Works well across teams to drive efficiency and effectiveness.
* **Self-Motivated:** Takes initiative and thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

## **Why Join Hawk-Eye?**

* Work with cutting-edge sports technology in a rapidly growing market.
* Play a key role in shaping Hawk-Eye's presence in both existing and emerging sports, including sports we have never worked in before.
* Be part of a global team with opportunities for career development and growth.

If you are a dynamic and ambitious commercial professional who enjoys creating opportunities rather than waiting for them, and you have a passion for expanding into new sports markets while strengthening our presence in current ones, we would love to hear from you.

**Everyone Hero –** Every individual matters and every contribution counts.

**Take Responsibility -** We own our actions and outcomes, individually and as a team

**About role:**

As a Category Project Manager, you will deliver flawless planning and implementation of portfolio related projects within the Baby and Toddler Snacks Category. You will drive all Category innovation and renovation snacking projects through the Global stage gate process from Consumer potential to Launch. In this role it is important to ensure that all stakeholders are engaged, and projects meet required targets and timings.

You will partner with the category team, cross functional and local marketing teams across Hero, and externally, with third party suppliers and design agencies

**Key Responsibilities**

*Project Programme Management*

* Own the programme view of all BTS Category snack food innovation/renovation projects.
* Work with the Category team to ensure the innovation pipeline is sufficient to deliver the business targets – helping to prioritise projects and required resource.
* Define the project teams -ensuring the PCM develops a Critical Time Path (CTP).
* Work closely day-to-day with cross functional teams- both internal and with external suppliers if required.
* Identify and elevate areas of project risk.
* Ensure flow of communication to key stakeholders.

*Project Management*

* Support execution of group portfolio, supply chain optimisation, innovation pipeline and future fit pipeline.
* Support in innovation pipeline ideation and concept testing.
* Create project briefs and build cross market business cases.
* Lead projects through our established frameworks (Global stage gate process).
* Manage cross country harmonisation and rationalisation initiatives.
* Establish close working relationships with local markets- attend monthly meetings for market updates and innovation alignments.
* Collaborate closely with R&D, Procurement, Quality and Supply Chain to ensure all projects meet nutritional, regulatory, compliance and sustainability standards.
* Ensure all launch and business criteria/parameters are achieved on multiple projects simultaneously, including project scope, timing, cost, quality, multiple stakeholder expectations.
* Assess project requests from local Marketing teams and the Category team. Provide preliminary technical, logistical, cost, timeline, customer service, risk/benefit and other feasibility implications. Ensuring launch success criteria are clearly defined.
* Prioritise and resolve multiple, conflicting inputs or projects and manage project financial risk and contingency planning with functional leaders.
* Assess the impact of upstream business decisions or technical changes/delays on downstream execution deliverables and resolve, proactively, the gaps between functional hand-offs.
* Manage project communication to business teams, across the organisation and to senior management. Assess and facilitate critical project decisions with business teams and/or senior management to ensure project priorities are optimised.
* Align with local market contacts to ensure projects are managed through the Global Stage Gate process and resources allocated, risks raised/mitigated/communicated.

* Versed in monitoring and analysing internal and external data sources

* Dedication to detail, able to zoom in and out
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across functions and international teams
* Problem solver: proactive and goal-oriented, fast, end-to-end thinking

London, UK

## Employment Type

Full time

## Department

Engineering

* Base Salary £110K – £170K • Offers Equity

OverviewApplication

**(Applicants must be based in London, UK)**

## About the role

We are seeking high-performing London-based engineers of any level to help us solve more of our customers’ problems. We are looking for folks who are excited about designing elegant technical solutions and shipping great code frequently. If you are looking for a fresh challenge at a fast-growing AI startup - we would love to hear from you!

### **What You’ll Do**

This is a hands-on (‘individual contributor’) role focused on building product that will solve our customers’ problems, including specifically:

* Designing, building and maintaining backend services and APIs
* Designing and building new UI/web components
* Developing new integrations to third party services and AI models
* Help triage bugs, investigate production incidents, and contribute to postmortems and root cause analysis
* Participating in code reviews, collaborating across technical and non-technical teams and stakeholders

## **What We’re Looking For**

Our ideal hire will:

* **Enjoy -actually- building and making an impact**: you get a kick out of shipping code frequently, iteratively, and collaboratively. You value MVPs and customer impact over perfectly engineered systems. You can take responsibility over the end-to-end deployment of what you build.
* **Thrive at solving tough technical problems**: you enjoy breaking down challenges into simple and well-designed solutions. You are fact-oriented and thoughtful in your approach, but you don’t get bogged down in over-intellectualizing or over-complicating things.
* **Scale-oriented**: while having a bias to action and impact, you will care about scalable infrastructure and engineering processes. Even better if you’re able to bring some better practices or improvements to our infrastructure or ways of working!
* **Be able to contribute in our stack**: we try to balance speed and impact with fitting the best framework/ technology to the task at hand. Currently, we work primarily in Python / Flask / FastAPI on the backend, Terraform / GCP / AWS for infra, and React / JavaScript / TypeScript / Vercel on the frontend. Ideally, you’ll be able to contribute within our stack while also helping us experiment and evolve to continually improve functionality and performance.

Above all else, we value people who want to make an impact in their work. Here are some of the behaviors that we expect of all Herons:

* **Scrappy and creative**: when faced with an obstacle, you will either overcome it by pure determination (i.e., by hand), or find an unconventional approach or ‘hack’ to navigate it.
* **Persistent**: you may not always find the right answer or person immediately, but you're motivated to keep on trying until you do so. You’ll go the extra mile - including Flying to Gainesville - if that’s what it takes.
* **Pilot not passenger:** at a fast-growing company like Heron we need people who jump on opportunities unprompted and drive them to a great outcome, rather than folks who wait to be told what to do.
* **Excited to work in a fast-paced, high-growth, team-based environment**: we aim to move quickly and decisively, but together. You’ll be a great team player and do what it takes for the team to succeed.

## **What You Can Expect as a Heron**

* Competitive compensation, including equity
* Based full-time in London, where most of the team is in-person multiple days per week
* Your choice of top-of-the-line equipment to fit out your desk in the office
* Occasional travel to NYC for retreats and to work with the team there
* Competitive benefits: health insurance; pension; uncapped annual leave; parental leave
* Free mental health support via Spill - on-demand access to therapy
* Weekly company lunches (always inclusive and vegan-friendly - especially if you like Korean or Vietnamese food!)
* Applicants from any background and gender are welcome and we have a zero tolerance policy on discrimination

## About the interview

* **Initial conversation (20 minutes)** - conversation to discuss what you're looking for, what Heron offers, and to see if there's a good fit.
* **Technical interview (up to 60 minutes)** - interactive technical session with one or two of our engineers where you will review a pull request and then do some live coding to build on it.
* **Team interviews (2-3 hours in total)** - mix of technical and behavioral conversations with Heron teammates and founders. You'll get a feel for the people you'll work with and how we approach problems, and we'll get to know how you collaborate, communicate, and think.
* **References** - 2 references from people you've worked with who can speak to your impact, working style, and contributions in a professional setting.

## About Heron Data

We are **Heron Data**, a Series A stage company based in New York and London.

* At Heron, we use the latest advances in AI and LLMs to automate document processing. Our software handles emails, analyzes attachments, and takes actions like updating CRMs or requesting more info to execute workflows end-to-end for our customers. We serve a range of businesses including some of the world's largest fintechs, banks and other specialty finance companies, commercial insurers, and more.
* Our largest product automates underwriting for small business lenders and other specialty finance companies. We eliminate cumbersome manual processes and enable our customers to provide their services with much greater speed, precision, and fairness.
* We are a rapidly growing company with over 150 customers in financial services and beyond who trust us to be embedded in critical processes - without us, their businesses stop. We analyze tens of thousands of documents a day, including over 20 million individual bank transactions daily for our customers. We continue to grow into more segments and workflows: further into lending, banking, insurance. And we think there's much more we can do!
* We are a lean, scrappy and committed team with a flat structure and collaborative culture. Our team brings together a wealth of experience from great tech companies including Facebook, Spotify, Revolut and many other startups from around the world.
* With team members from five different continents, we embrace multiculturalism and diversity. From company events to everyday interactions, we make sure everyone feels welcome and accommodate all cultural and dietary requirements.
* Since our launch in September 2020, at the end of the S20 batch, we've experienced a lot of growth! Today, we serve over 190 customers and have over $13M in ARR. Read more about our mission **here**

* Perform schedule quality reviews and ensure project schedules comply with established planning standards and governance requirements.

* Establish project baselines and support project teams during project start-up and planning activities.
* Carry out pre-planning activities including reviews of scope of work, contractual requirements, work breakdown structures, engineering deliverables and project interfaces.
* Work with suppliers, subcontractors and third parties to ensure plans are realistic and achievable and analyse contractor schedule performance.
* Support risk and change assessments through schedule impact analysis and what-if scenario planning.
* Promote planning best practices and contribute to the continuous improvement of project planning processes.

* Degree qualified in Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience.

* Thorough understanding of logical sequencing and interfacing of project execution activities in EPC projects.

We are looking for a hands-on Robotics End-Effector Integration Engineer to bring grippers, actuators and sensors from prototype components to reliable robot systems. You will assemble and integrate prototypes, build test rigs, evaluate competing technologies and use data to help select production components.

You will also troubleshoot end-effector issues across mechanical, electrical, controls and software interfaces, identify root causes and feed improvements back to the relevant engineering teams. This role is ideal for a practical, multidisciplinary engineer who enjoys building, testing and debugging complex robotic hardware.

# What You'll Do

* **System Integration**

  + **Parallel Workstreams:** As the robot design matures, the complexity will increase. You will support integration streams to ensure mechanisms, actuators, sensors, electronics, controls, and robot software fit together physically and logically.
  + **Prototype Builds:** Support the physical assembly, wiring, bring-up, calibration, and robot-level validation of early end-effector prototypes, verifying that mechanical interfaces, harnesses, sensor data, and control interfaces behave correctly.

  **2. End-Effector & Sensor Evaluation (R&D)**

  + **Component Shootouts:** We have multiple options for grippers, actuators, tactile sensors, force/torque sensors, and related components, but we need data to make the final decision. You will build test rigs and run "shootout" tests to compare candidates against each other.
  + **Test Rig Creation:** Design and build quick-turn mechanical and electrical rigs to mount, calibrate, and test end-effectors and sensors (e.g., measuring force/torque sensor drift, tactile sensor repeatability, gripper force, or actuator backlash).
  + **Data Analysis:** Capture raw sensor and actuator data and assess accuracy, repeatability, hysteresis, drift, noise, bandwidth, and integration feasibility. Your reports will determine which components make it into the BOM.

  **3.Fleet Support & Root Cause Analysis (Immediate Impact)**

  + **Triage & Debug:** Act as the second line of engineering defense for end-effectors and related sensors on newly built robots. When a gripper, tactile sensor, force/torque sensor, actuator, or tool interface fails in the field or the lab, you investigate why.
  + **Root Cause Analysis (RCA):** Deep dive into mechanical, electrical, controls, and software evidence to identify the source of failures. You will distinguish between a "bad part," a "bad assembly," a "bad calibration," or a "bad design."
  + **Feedback Loop:** Document your findings and feed them back to the mechanical, electrical, controls, and software teams, allowing them to focus on long-term fixes rather than daily firefighting.

* **Experience:** 3+ years in Robotics, Mechatronics, or integration Engineering. You have taken a complex electromechanical system from "parts on a table" to working reliably on a robot.
* **Hardware Debugging:** You are comfortable using oscilloscopes, multimeters, and logic analyzers to debug harness, PCB, sensor, actuator, and communications issues. You aren't afraid to strip wires, solder a patch cable, or build a test fixture.
* **End-Effector & Sensor Knowledge:** Solid understanding of robotic grippers, actuators, tactile sensing, force/torque sensing, encoders, load cells, or related mechatronic systems. You understand calibration, repeatability, hysteresis, drift, noise, and sampling behavior.
* **Software Competency:** Familiarity with Linux and Python to write or modify scripts that capture and analyze sensor data. Familiarity with ROS/ROS2 to visualize data, record bags, inspect topics, and debug drivers. Familiarity with Git.

* Mechanical CAD experience (SolidWorks/Siemens NX) to design simple end-effector mounts, brackets, and test fixtures.
