# Data & Analytics Transformation Lead

## A high-impact leadership role within Data & Analytics, created for 6–9 months to support the next phase of the function’s evolution following the Global Data Platform (GDP) delivery.

Looking for a challenge in one of the world’s largest airfreight logistics organisations?

At IAG Cargo we are in the business of moving things. From antibiotics to groundbreaking tech, gold bullion to avocados and everything in between. We move cargo that positively impacts society worldwide. Whatever people need, wherever they are. At IAG Cargo we open the skies and fly the world to bring people the things they really need.  

We are the logistics and cargo brand of International Airlines Group (Aer Lingus, British Airways, Iberia, Level and Vueling). Powered by five airlines, our reach is truly global – but it’s the impact we make that defines us. At IAG Cargo, we believe in keeping the world’s economies turning, and do everything with determined attitudes, curious minds, collaborative actions and heartfelt pride. Join us at our globally recognised logistics business, that is Trusted to Deliver.

#### **About the role**

This is a high-impact leadership grade transformation role within the Data & Analytics team, established on a temporary 6–9 month basis to help shape and deliver the next stage of the function’s evolution following the delivery of the Global Data Platform (GDP).

The role will focus on turning new platform capability into measurable business value: strengthening senior stakeholder relationships, improving demand management and delivery focus, transforming business self-service analytics, and making the link between Data & Analytics activity and business benefit clearer and more consistent.

You will work across the Data & Analytics leadership team, business functions and enabling partners to define the strategic changes needed for the team to maximise GDP, while also assessing the longer-term capability transformation required to mature advanced analytics, machine learning and AI adoption across IAG Cargo.

A key part of the role will be to help move the function from a predominantly request-led delivery model towards a more value-led, product-minded and business-outcome focused operating model.

#### **What you’ll do**

* Maximise value from GDP: Lead the organisational and behavioural changes required to fully realise the benefits of our new Global Data Platform (GDP), embedding trusted data, analytics and reporting into business decision-making.
* Transform business analytics capability: Define and implement the strategy, operating model and governance required to increase business self-sufficiency, data literacy and adoption of analytical capabilities across IAG Cargo.
* Strengthen business partnership and stakeholder engagement: Establish a more strategic relationship with senior leaders, ensuring Data & Analytics priorities are aligned to business objectives, transformation programmes and measurable outcomes.
* Improve portfolio management and delivery effectiveness: Enhance demand management, prioritisation and governance processes to focus resources on the highest-value opportunities and improve delivery transparency, accountability and outcomes.
* Embed value-led performance management: Introduce frameworks that clearly connect Data & Analytics activity and investment to business benefits, enabling consistent measurement, reporting and value realisation.
* Define the future Data & Analytics capability strategy: Develop the roadmap, operating model and organisational recommendations required to scale business partnering, data products, advanced analytics, machine learning and AI capabilities over the next 3–5 years.

#### **It's all about you**

What you’ll bring to IAG Cargo:

We're looking for an experienced transformation leader with a track record of delivering business change in complex organisations. You will be comfortable operating at senior leadership level, building trusted relationships with stakeholders and influencing decisions that drive measurable business outcomes.

You will combine strategic thinking with practical delivery, helping organisations maximise the value of technology and data investments through improved operating models, business adoption and effective change management. You will be equally comfortable shaping future direction and driving execution.

We're seeking someone who can bring clarity to complexity, challenge constructively and establish a strong focus on value, prioritisation and business outcomes. You'll be a confident communicator with the ability to translate complex concepts into compelling narratives, recommendations and action plans for senior leaders.

Above all, you'll be a collaborative and pragmatic leader who can inspire change, build alignment across diverse stakeholders and leave behind sustainable improvements that continue to deliver value beyond the life of the programme.

Skills and Experience:

* Experience operating in complex, fast-moving organisations with multiple stakeholders, priorities and competing demands.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience engaging senior leaders and driving alignment across functions.
* Good understanding of Data & Analytics, including data platforms, self-service analytics, AI and digital capabilities.
* Experience leading business, process and behavioural change, delivering sustainable adoption of new ways of working.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including benefits realisation, value measurement and investment prioritisation.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes and actions.

**To apply, candidates must:**

* Must have a numerate background with either relevant degree or professional experience
* Must have the right to live and work full-time in the UK
* Must be able to pass a Criminal Record Check.
* Be able to work in a hybrid environment, including regular time at Carrus, LHR, and occasional travel where business needs require.

#### We’ll treat you right

Wherever you work within IAG Cargo, you’ll play a part in helping us deliver what the world needs and join a diverse and inclusive business that’s making a difference.

As well as a competitive salary, bonus, we offer a range of benefits to support our colleagues, which include:

* A hybrid environment with 3 days a week in the office and two from home.
* From the day you join us, you’ll get access to brilliant staff travel benefits including unlimited basic and premium standby tickets on British Airways and group airlines. You’ll also receive up to 30 discounted ‘Hotline’ airfares per year for yourself, friends, and family.
* Flexible bank holiday policy- Individuals not on shift have the flexibility to swap the statutory public holidays, with the days you choose to take off instead.
* All our colleagues get access to LinkedIn learning and Rosetta Stone Language courses
* For health and wellbeing we offer a free onsite gym facility as well as access to the UNMIND app and a community of Mental Health First Aiders
* Access to discounts on Apple, Cinema tickets and loads of other goodies through Perks at work

**Diversity and Inclusion**

Our recruitment procedures positively support our diversity and inclusion agenda.

All candidates are considered strictly on their merits in relation to the criteria for the role, treated fairly and consistently, and have their individual needs responded to throughout the process.

* Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).
* Strong post-qualified experience within financial accounting, financial control or management accounting.
* Proven experience leading the month-end close in a multi-entity environment.
* Strong balance sheet reconciliation and financial reporting experience.
* Experience leading and developing finance teams.

* Experience using Unit4, Sage or similar ERP systems is preferable.

* Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.

* Process improvement mindset with a collaborative approach.

## Payroll Officer – Ireland & UK

Healthy animals and happy owners – that’s the goal.

The Payroll Officer will be responsible for the accurate, timely and compliant delivery of the internal Irish payroll using Sage Payroll, while also providing support and resilience across UK payroll activities. The role requires strong payroll knowledge, excellent data capability and a clear governance and controls mindset.

The successful candidate will ensure payroll activity is well controlled, fully evidenced and audit ready. They will work closely with HR, Finance, operational leaders and the wider payroll team to improve data quality, strengthen reconciliations and support continuous improvement through automation where practical.

## Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities:

**Payroll delivery**  
 Manage the end-to-end processing of the Irish payroll using Sage Payroll, ensuring all payroll cycles are completed accurately and within agreed deadlines. Support UK payroll processing where required, including employee lifecycle changes, statutory payments, deductions, payroll adjustments, year-end activity and statutory reporting.

**Variable pay and payroll inputs**  
 Review, validate and process variable pay, including overtime, bonuses, commissions, shift premiums, on-call payments, allowances, expenses and other payroll inputs. Confirm that supporting evidence and approval records are complete before processing, and investigate unusual payments, retrospective adjustments or one-off transactions before payroll approval.

**Payroll controls and validation**  
 Validate payroll inputs received from HR, Finance and operational teams to confirm completeness, accuracy and authorisation. Complete pre-payroll and post-payroll checks, payroll variance analysis, duplicate checks and exception reviews.   
 Maintain clear evidence for all payroll transactions, adjustments and control activities in line with internal governance standards.

**Reconciliations and financial control**  
 Perform payroll reconciliations after each payroll cycle, reconciling payroll outputs to source inputs, approval records, payroll journals and General Ledger postings. Investigate reconciliation differences and ensure timely resolution.   
 Support payroll-related balance sheet reconciliations, month-end close and year-end financial reporting.

**Automation and continuous improvement**  
 Develop and maintain practical control tools, exception reports and reconciliation routines using Excel, Power Query and available reporting solutions. Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve data quality and strengthen payroll controls. Support system testing, process improvements and enhancements to payroll reporting.

**Compliance and governance**  
 Ensure compliance with Irish payroll legislation, Revenue requirements, pension obligations and statutory reporting standards. Support UK payroll compliance with HMRC requirements where required.   
 Maintain payroll records in accordance with internal policy, data protection requirements and audit evidence standards.

**Stakeholder management**  
 Build effective relationships with employees, managers, HR, Finance and operational stakeholders across Ireland and the UK. Respond to payroll queries professionally, explain payroll outcomes clearly and work collaboratively to resolve issues at source.   
 Support the Irish leadership team through regular engagement and occasional in-person meetings.

## Experience/Qualifications:

**Essential:**  
 Irish payroll delivery Confident end-to-end payroll processing, including inputs, calculations, approvals, statutory reporting and payroll close.  
 UK Payroll awareness Practical understanding of UK payroll processes, statutory requirements and payroll controls to provide cross-cover and resilience.  
 Governance and controls Strong controls mindset, with the ability to evidence checks, challenge exceptions and maintain audit-ready payroll records.  
 Data analysis Strong Excel capability, including reconciliations, variance analysis, lookups, pivot tables, data validation and exception reporting.  
 Variable pay validation Ability to review and challenge overtime, bonuses, allowances, one-off payments and retrospective adjustments before payroll approval.  
 Reconciliations Ability to reconcile payroll outputs to source data, approval records, payroll journals and General Ledger postings.  
 Automation mindset Comfortable using available tools to reduce manual effort, improve reporting quality and strengthen recurring control activities.  
 Stakeholder communication Clear, professional communication with employees, managers, HR, Finance and operational teams, with the ability to explain payroll matters in plain language.  
 Confidentiality and judgement High level of discretion, sound judgement and respect for sensitive employee and payroll data.

**Desirable:**  
 Experience in a multi-site or multi-country organisation would be beneficial, together with exposure to payroll audits, control testing, risk management, process improvement or payroll system change. An understanding of General Ledger postings and payroll-related balance sheet reconciliations would also be advantageous.

About Kappa
African businesses import $700 billion worth of goods and services per year but paying their suppliers abroad remains a massive challenge. Their options today are limited to traditional banks and the black market. Going through banks means poor customer service, high transaction costs and unfavorable exchange rates. Transactions that should take a few days end up taking weeks and cost merchants up to 9% in fees. The situation is equally dire for consumers who pay some of the highest P2P transfer fees in the world and are stuck with mobile money technology that is now decades old. We are building Kappa to fix that. Our cross-border payments platform is designed for ultra low-cost, near-instant money transfer at significantly higher transaction sizes than what’s currently possible. Our mission is to break down the barriers that have held back African businesses for decades.
About the opportunity
Kappa is looking for a Product Owner to join the team and help scale up our cross-border payments platform in Africa and beyond. Coming in early, you will take full ownership of the product across mobile and web and be end-responsible for delivering value to customers. Part of a globally distributed team spread across Africa, Europe and the Middle East, this role comes with significant autonomy, and offers a chance to help build a massive business that will have a positive impact on millions of lives. Our platform has processed over $1 billion across tens of thousands of transactions for African businesses, but we are just getting started. We have big ambitions as we scale up in existing markets and roll out in new ones, and we are looking for someone with matching ambition to drive that expansion.

You'll take end-to-end ownership of our web and mobile apps — from talking to customers and framing the problem, through the requirements and the design, to what the numbers say in production

You’ll spend real time with the people who use our product — Importers and exporters in Africa, from SMEs to multi-nationals, and our sales and operations teams on the ground who talk to them every day
You’ll design flows for reliability, robustness and scale — You'll spend as much time on what happens when a transaction fails or gets stuck as on the happy path
What you'll bring
5+ years in product management. Experience with fintech products (payments, lending, banking) is a hard requirement. Plus points for cross-border payments and for building in emerging markets
Payments fluency — Settlement, reconciliation, chargebacks, RFIs, treasury and liquidity. You treat KYC, AML and licensing as constraints that factor into the design from day one, not as blockers that show up late
Writing that makes building unambiguous — Problem, customers, success criteria and constraints come before any solution. Two engineers (or coding agents) reading your spec independently would build the same thing
Design judgment and the ability to act on it — You can say why one screen works better than another in terms of what the customer is looking to achieve. You’re able to produce the flows yourself using AI-driven tooling (e.g. Pen.dev, Claude Design) rather than relying on a designer
Technical credibility — You can read an API schema or contract, follow an architecture discussion, and know when a requirement you've written is accidentally expensive or comes with hidden complexity. You have a sense for what’s hard vs easy to build.
Range and operating across layers of context — You can give the CEO the two lines that matter and the engineer the edge case that breaks the design, and go deeper when needed

This is not a traditional training role with AI added on. It is an enterprise enablement and behaviour-change role, with a clear focus on real workflows, measurable impact and responsible use.

* Develop and maintain a practical AI learning and enablement roadmap aligned to Kroll’s enterprise AI strategy, approved tools, governance expectations and service-line priorities.

* Design, build and deliver AI learning pathways covering AI literacy, responsible use, prompt practices, role-based use cases, workflow application, advanced features and practical adoption for priority teams.

* Develop and maintain AI Deployment Playbooks
* Create practical learning assets including prompt packs, first-five-prompts resources, role-based workflow guides, use case exercises, manager toolkits, leader briefing materials, champion, citizen development, builder enablement resources, responsible AI guidance and adoption communications.

The role
You'll own the backend systems Letly runs on — and the architecture other engineers build on: the software behind every viewing, tenancy, certificate, rent payment and repair. These are systems where correctness, reliability and scale are non-negotiable: real people's money, homes and legal exposure are on the line.
This is a senior-to-staff hire. At senior you own systems others build on — you make the architecture calls, set the patterns, and raise the bar around you. At staff you own the technical direction of a domain: you decide what gets built and how, you unblock other engineers, and you answer for how those systems behave under load.
What you'll work on
Money movement. Rent, deposits and payouts through pooled client-money accounts — idempotent processing, split-settlement, exactly-once across service and bank boundaries.
Reconciliation & bookings. A penny-accurate, self-healing ledger reconciling bank activity across thousands of tenancies; contended scheduling — viewings, certs, photography, maintenance against finite slots and vendor availability.
Event-driven consistency. Services coordinating over Pub/Sub — sagas across offer → contract → tenancy → payment with no distributed transaction to lean on. LLM tool calling, deterministic API calls, and other intra- and inter-service communications all running across the same coordination system.
AI harnesses in production. Deploying agentic AI into real-world operational settings — acting on real money, tenancies and legal exposure, with the guardrails, observability and correctness that demands. Non-deterministic LLM working within compliant, secure deterministic software.
Our stack
We build on NestJS + TypeScript on GCP / GKE, with MongoDB, Redis and GCP Pub/Sub.
You don't need to arrive fluent in it. We hire strong backend engineers who've built production systems with any robust framework — Java/Spring Boot, Go, Kotlin, C#/.NET, Python (Django/FastAPI) or Ruby on Rails — and can ramp into TypeScript fast. We care that you've built and operated real backends, not which language you did it in.
How we build
Small, well-factored services. TDD and DDD as defaults. Trunk-based CI/CD — you ship to production and own it, with tests, observability and clean rollbacks. Lean frameworks, readable code, and we move fast because the tests and boundaries let us.
What we're looking for
6+ years building and operating production backend systems (more, for staff).
Fluency in at least one backend language and framework, and the range to reason about system design — services, data models, APIs, failure modes.
Real distributed-systems experience: eventual consistency, idempotency, concurrency, and their failure modes at production scale.
Strong API and data modelling (document or relational), plus cloud / containerised deployment (GCP or AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).
AI-Native engineer: you use AI across all layers of your work and utilise models expertly while understanding LLM failure modes and patterns.
Senior: a track record of designing systems other engineers built on, and of raising a team's standard.
Staff: you've set technical direction across several services or teams, and you're the person others escalate to when it's hard.
Nice to have
MongoDB and GCP/GKE.
Event-driven architecture and message brokers (Pub/Sub, Kafka).
Payments, ledgers, reconciliation, or another money-movement / financial-correctness domain.
Fintech or another regulated, high-trust environment.
Who does well here
You're precise about correctness — these systems move money; "mostly right" fails.
You own the outcome, not the ticket — start to production, without being chased.
You make the next engineer faster — clear code, clear reasoning.
You want the hard problems — and you raise the standard around you.
Why apply
Letly is the AI-Native operating company built for the home. We believe the home will be autonomously run by AI and we're building the software that will run all rental properties end-to-end, starting with London (the world's 2nd largest rental city).

Every Letly customer is served by the system you build, and the work compounds — every service and primitive keeps producing value after you ship it.
We've raised a $4m pre-seed from investors who've built the financial and operational infrastructure that moves billions and serves millions. They backed us because the home is the largest consumer asset where that infrastructure hasn't been built yet. The operator console. The internal system the business is actually run on. Every hour of manual work you design out is margin — our north star is a property that autonomously runs itself.

We're looking for an experienced Business Analyst with strong **Contentful** and headless CMS experience to join our Content Domain team and help shape the next phase of our enterprise content platform. You'll play a key role in designing scalable content models, improving governance and enabling teams to maximise the capabilities of **Contentful** across multiple digital products and channels.

This is a hybrid strategic and delivery-focused role, combining business analysis, structured content modelling and content system enablement. You'll help evolve the organisation from a centralised "content gatekeeper" model to a scalable, self-service approach that enables Product, UX and Engineering teams to move faster with greater consistency, confidence and reuse.

Working closely with Product, Experience Design, Engineering and Platform teams, you'll help define scalable, reusable and API-ready content structures that support modern digital experiences across multiple channels and touchpoints.

Over the past year, we've made significant progress adopting a headless CMS approach using Contentful, enabling structured content reuse across a growing range of digital experiences and channels. Contentful is at the centre of our digital content ecosystem, supporting structured content delivery across web, mobile and emerging digital channels. As our implementation matures, we're looking for someone who understands not only content modelling, but also how to get the best from the Contentful platform through governance, reusable content types, environments, workflows and content operations.

As adoption has scaled across teams, several common challenges have emerged:

* Existing content models are difficult to discover and understand
* Reuse versus new model creation is inconsistent
* Documentation is fragmented and hard to navigate

The Brand Designer joins Moonfare's Marketing team - a high-output team responsible for building the brand, setting standards of excellence, generating demand, and driving investor acquisition across global markets. You will work daily with Fund Marketing, Investor Relations and Compliance, and you will own the craft rather than coordinate it. This role reports to the CMO.

* Own the craft on every investor-facing surface - fund brochures, the annual letter, invitations, event environments, sales decks, web pages, paid assets - and hold the line on quality when the deadline argues otherwise.

* Take long-form and content design seriously - due diligence summaries, research, the annual letter - where the job is clarity and restraint rather than decoration.

MrQ - we're an awesome, award winning online casino launched in 2018. We're big on tech, big on performance and most of all - big on fun. Over the years, we have experienced explosive growth - which means we need more rock stars to join our quest for total world domination.
MrQ's Product org is full of brilliant people. The problem isn't the talent. It's the tax.
As an org scales, the work stops being the bottleneck — the coordination around the work does. Status decks that exist to translate a decision someone already made. Meetings to align on the other meetings. A Scorecard that reads green right up until the moment it's red. Heads and PMs spending their sharpest hours on glue instead of on the product.
This role exists to kill that tax and give the org its time back.
The old answer to scale was more process and more meetings. The new answer is automation, tooling, and just enough process to keep it tight. Same goals — alignment, visibility, nothing falling through the cracks — reached without stealing everyone's week to get there.
You are the operator who makes the whole Product machine run — and the person the CPO hands the ambiguous, cross-functional, "someone just needs to own this" problems to, knowing they'll get closed. Part operating system, part chief of staff. You don't build a department to do this. You do it yourself, with AI and judgement, at a level most people need a team to reach.
This is a Principal role in the truest sense: you operate, you don't administrate.
What you'll do
You own the operating system. The Product cadence, the Scorecard, the Rocks, the rituals that keep Product moving — they're yours. Not as a note-taker, as the owner who makes them sharp, cuts the ones that don't earn their place, and makes sure decisions actually land instead of dissolving between meetings.
You take work off the CPO's plate. The chief-of-staff edge. The half-defined, politically awkward, falls-between-functions things that would otherwise sit on Aidan's desk for three weeks — you pick them up, drive them, and close them. You're trusted with real decisions, not just prep.
You make the org faster. You hunt the coordination tax and remove it. Better tooling, fewer rituals, tighter throughput. If a process isn't making the work better, you burn it.
You're the early-warning system. When a Company Scorecard metric starts to drift, you see it first. You convene the response — The Assemble — and you run it the way it's meant to run: supportive, fast, fix-focused, not a hunt for someone to blame.
You see the whole board. Across every tribe and mission, you spot the dependencies, the conflicts, and the quiet single points of failure before they bite. You connect dots nobody else is positioned to see.
You build AI-natively. Not a tool bolted on at the end. It's how you operate from day one — automating the reporting, the synthesis, the chasing. The ops function stays lean precisely because you've built it to run on AI, not headcount.
What makes this different
You operate, you don't administrate. This is not a PMO. No process for process's sake. No governance theatre. Your job is to make work happen faster, not to create more of it.
No siloes — yours included. This is an ops role, but ownership isn't fenced off here. Interested in building a piece of Product itself? Brilliant — go take a piece and build it. The "everyone builds" rule applies to you too.
Small footprint, big leverage. You're a Principal IC, not a manager building an empire. Your output comes from judgement and AI, not from people reporting to you.
Direct line to the CPO. You work shoulder-to-shoulder with Aidan. You're trusted with ambiguity and real calls — and expected to challenge, not just execute.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

## Senior Analyst, Advisory

****About Novata****

Novata is a public benefit corporation founded by a unique consortium of leading foundations and private-sector organizations, including the Ford Foundation, the Omidyar Network, S&P Global, and Hamilton Lane. Our mission is to empower the private markets to build a more inclusive and sustainable form of capitalism. We do this by providing best-in-class technology and tools to help clients collect, analyze, benchmark, and report ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) data. With a diverse, experienced, and mission-driven team, we are building a company that values both performance and purpose.

Novata is proud to have acquired Atlas Metrics to expand our global reach and expand our product innovation. Together, we make sustainability even simpler for private markets. Now, 400+ clients and over 13,000 companies worldwide count on Novata to make collecting, reporting, and acting on sustainability data easy.

****\*Fluency in German required for this role\*****

****About Novata Advisory****

Backed by platform data and insights from more than 13,000 private companies, Novata Advisory enhances our market-leading technology solution with a suite of offerings that maximise the value of the Novata experience, partnering with private equity GPs and their portfolio companies to translate ESG data into decisions that drive measurable value. The Advisory team works across the full ESG spectrum, from carbon accounting and climate risk to governance, social, and impact reporting, delivering engagements that are directly integrated with Novata's technology platform.

Advisory is purpose-built to challenge the traditional consulting model: AI-led offerings and workflows, vibe coding, prototyping, custom solutions, and a tight feedback loop with Product mean that Advisory operates as both a client delivery function and an engine for innovation. **About You:**

We're looking for a Senior Content Strategist to be the bridge between our ideas and the channels that bring them to life - across all three tiers of our content: big brand campaigns, monthly launch moments, and the always-on cultural content that runs underneath both. You'll take each of these and work out how it gets cut, adapted, and sequenced across every marketing and brand channel we run: social, email, paid, web, PR, in-store/experiential, and beyond. You're not the one inventing the big idea, and you're not the one hitting publish on every post - you're the person who works out what each idea becomes on each channel, in what order, and in what format, so everything we put out feels like one connected story, whether it's a hero campaign or a same-day community post.

**You'll be responsible for:**

- Translate campaign briefs and creative concepts into a channel-by-channel activation plan across all three content tiers - big campaigns, monthly launch moments, and always-on/cultural content - defining what content each channel needs, in what format, and when.

- Partner with brand/creative teams to understand the core idea behind a campaign or launch, then work backwards into practical content requirements for social, email, paid media, web, PR, and experiential.

- Own the always-on content plan: identify and react to cultural moments, trends, and real-time opportunities, and work out how they connect back to the broader brand and campaign narrative rather than sitting apart from it.

- Build content cascades and calendars that sequence big-campaign, monthly, and always-on content together, so they reinforce rather than compete with one another.

- Identify where a single asset can be cut, resized, or re-cut for different channels versus where a channel or moment needs bespoke content.

- Work with the producers brief designers, copywriters, and agencies on channel-specific adaptations, formats, and specs - from hero campaign assets down to fast-turnaround cultural content.

- Ensure tone, messaging hierarchy, and creative integrity hold up across tiers: from big-canvas assets (hero films, key visuals) to channel-native formats (Reels, carousels, email modules, banners) to reactive always-on posts.

- Work with the social team to take insights across channel and content performance and iterate the content mix - across campaigns, launches, and always-on - based on what's landing.

**You'll need to have:**

- 8+ years in content strategy, integrated marketing, or campaign management, ideally within a brand, agency, or editorial team.

- Proven experience taking an idea - campaign, launch, or cultural moment - and adapting it across multiple channels (paid, owned, earned, social, email).

- Comfortable operating at different speeds: the long-lead planning of a tentpole campaign, the monthly rhythm of launch moments, and the fast turnaround of always-on/reactive content.

- Strong grasp of channel-specific best practice: what works natively on each platform versus what's just a resized asset.

- Comfortable briefing and collaborating with creative, design, and production teams - you can speak both "strategy" and "production."

- Excellent organizational skills; you can hold a content calendar spanning campaigns, launches, and always-on posting with dozens of moving parts and keep it coherent.

- Data-literate: able to read channel and content performance and adjust the direction accordingly.

- A sharp eye for narrative consistency - you protect the throughline as ideas fragment across channels and content tiers.

- A pulse on social trends, with good judgment on what's worth reacting to and what isn't.

**Nice to Have:**

- Experience with campaign management or project tools (Monday) and content calendars.

- Familiarity with paid and organic social platforms, email platforms, and basic web/CMS workflows.

- Prior experience in a hybrid brand/performance marketing team.

# Machine Learning Engineer

Manchester, UK · Full-time

Apply

About Precica

## Who we are.

Precica (precica.ai) is a deep-tech spinout of the University of Manchester, backed by Northern Gritstone and Deeptech Labs. Our product, pdata, compresses data by orders of magnitude whilst keeping it directly queryable — with applications in analytics, ML, querying, and forecasting. We're running live pilots in electricity markets and expanding into unstructured data (video, logs, sensor streams). Precica is an early-stage company with a small founding team, tackling one of the defining infrastructure problems of the coming decade: the cost, energy, and carbon footprint of dark data.

The Role

## What you'll do.

We're seeking a Machine Learning Engineer with a focus on neural and learned data compression. The role involves designing, implementing, and optimising compression models that underpin pdata's core engine.

Responsibilities include developing and benchmarking compression pipelines for structured and unstructured data, performing statistical evaluation of rate–distortion and query-accuracy trade-offs, and deploying models into production and pilot environments.

You will work directly with the founding team to translate research advances into scalable product capability, maintain code quality and reproducibility, and contribute to technical documentation and white papers.

As one of the first technical hires, you will have unusual scope to shape the company's technical direction. Responsibility at Precica grows with contribution and with the company itself — those who build the core of the product will be well placed to lead as we scale.

Requirements

## What we're looking for.

Essential

* Strong foundation in Computer Science: data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles.
* Applied expertise in machine learning, with hands-on experience building and tuning models on real-world data.
* In-depth understanding of neural architectures relevant to compression and representation learning.
* Proficiency in statistics, probability, and experimental design for rigorous model evaluation.
* Fluency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn) and adaptability to work across frameworks.
* Experience with large datasets, data pipelines, and version control (Git).
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and document work thoroughly.
* Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.

Desirable

* Direct experience with neural or learned compression: quantisation-aware training, rate–distortion optimisation, or learned transforms.
* Postgraduate degree or research experience in machine learning, information theory, signal processing, or data compression.
* Background in low-rank or structured representations (e.g. tensor decompositions, sketching, dimensionality reduction).
* Experience with time-series modelling and forecasting, particularly in energy or industrial settings.
* Familiarity with embedding-based retrieval and video/image representation learning (e.g. CLIP-style models, vector search).
* Performance engineering skills: C++, CUDA, or optimisation of inference pipelines for throughput and memory.
* Experience deploying models to production (MLOps, containerisation, CI/CD) and with cloud or HPC environments.
* Publications, open-source contributions, or patents in a relevant area.

Logistics

## A few practical details.

* Minimum education: Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience.
* Required field of study: Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field relevant to the role.
* Minimum years of experience: This is an entry-level role — we weigh demonstrated ability and relevant project or research experience over years on paper.
* Location-based hybrid policy: Precica is based in Manchester, UK. This role is hybrid — specific in-office expectations will be confirmed during the interview process.
* Visa sponsorship: We do not currently sponsor visas — we don't hold a sponsorship licence. You must already have the right to work in the UK to apply for this role.

We encourage you to apply even if you don't believe you meet every single qualification listed. Not all strong candidates tick every box, and research shows that people from underrepresented groups are especially prone to underestimating their own fit — so please don't rule yourself out prematurely. Problems like the one we're solving benefit from a wide range of perspectives, and we're building Precica with that in mind.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Precica recruiters only contact you from @precica.ai email addresses — be cautious of emails from other domains claiming to represent us. Legitimate Precica recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links — get in touch with us directly at contact@precica.ai to confirm.

# Product Owner

**We’re building the UK’s next generation engineering powerhouse, providing critical technology that strengthens national security and resilience.**

We specialise in turning advances in sensing, AI, and communications into operational capability for the edge, where connectivity may be degraded or denied. Our work focuses on accelerating the deployment of technology, improving decision-making for frontline teams, and protecting people and critical assets in demanding environments.  
  
Headquartered in Bristol, Rowden employs around 200 people and operates over 20,000 square feet of engineering and manufacturing facilities. We have a growing international footprint and are one of Europe’s fastest-growing engineering businesses.

**About the role**

Dovetail is Rowden's edge first software platform for configuring, securing and managing frontline operator systems. It covers the situational awareness kit, radios and end user devices that dismounted troops and system integrators rely on in the field. It is built to keep working when connectivity cannot be guaranteed, using offline first Edge Nodes, encrypted local state, signed configuration profiles and a central Edge Manager that syncs as soon as a connection becomes available.

We're looking for a Senior Product Owner to take ownership of the Dovetail roadmap end to end, working across Edge Manager and Edge Node capabilities and mentoring other Product Owners as the team grows. Dovetail is licensed to hardware vendors and system integrators, so the roadmap is shaped as much by integration constraints and security requirements as by internal priorities.

This is a hands on, technical role. You will be reading feature specs that cover RBAC models, sync conflict handling, VPN based connectivity and artefact signing, and you need to be comfortable working at that level of detail rather than relying on engineers to translate it for you.  
  
While this role offers hybrid working options, it requires a minimum of 3 days per week on-site at our Bristol HQ, with travel to customer sites.

**Candidates must be eligible for SC clearance.**

More information about security clearance is available here:

https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels

## Key areas of responsibility

* Make and defend prioritisation trade-offs where requirements conflict, for example offline first constraints against partner feature requests or security hardening.
* Maintain a backlog that holds up to technical scrutiny: clear, testable and sequenced against real dependencies rather than business value alone.
* Translate integration requirements from system integrators and hardware vendors into epics, features and user stories that engineering can build against.
* Write and review acceptance criteria for features involving device lifecycle, identity and access management, sync behaviour and data models, with enough precision that ambiguity does not surface mid sprint.
* Work directly with engineering leads on architectural trade-offs, such as sync conflict resolution or the API contracts between Edge Node and Edge Manager, rather than deferring technical decisions entirely to the team.
* Mentor other Product Owners as the Dovetail team grows, setting the standard for backlog quality, stakeholder handling and requirement clarity.
* Represent the product at a senior level in front of leadership, partners and customers.
* Act as the primary product contact for system integrators and hardware vendors evaluating or building on Dovetail.
* Balance the needs of internal engineering, external partners and security or compliance stakeholders, who will not always agree with each other.
* Run backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and acceptance of completed work.
* Ensure UX, engineering and QA are aligned on scope before commitment, not after.

## Key skills, experience and behaviours

We are looking for a senior product practitioner with the technical depth, judgement and experience to own a roadmap, make architectural trade-offs and act as a trusted voice for engineering, partners and leadership alike.

**Essential skills and experience**

* 5+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, including time owning a roadmap rather than administering a backlog for a technical or platform product.
* Comfortable reading and reasoning about API contracts, data models and system architecture diagrams without engineering translating it for you.
* Working understanding of client-server sync patterns, such as offline first design, eventual consistency and conflict resolution, and why they matter for product decisions.
* Familiarity with authentication and authorisation concepts (OIDC, RBAC, token based authentication) sufficient to write acceptance criteria that hold up under review.
* Experience writing user stories and specifications for backend or platform features, not only UI facing ones.
* Demonstrable experience working with external integration partners, licensees, or OEM and hardware vendors, rather than purely consumer or internal tools experience.
* Proven track record mentoring or informally leading other Product Owners or junior product staff.
* Fluent in Agile delivery (Scrum or Kanban), with hands on experience in Jira or an equivalent tool beyond basic backlog administration.

**Desirable (not essential)**

* Experience in defence, security, critical infrastructure or another regulated sector.
* Prior exposure to edge computing, IoT device management or MDM style platforms.
* Experience with defence or military procurement cycles, or working alongside system integrators on MOD or NATO aligned programmes.
* Familiarity with SQL or data querying, sufficient to explore device state or sync data directly rather than always requesting a report.

**About you**

# Commercial Finance Manager - Sainsbury's Financial Services

#### Salary: Competitive Plus Benefits Location: London Store Support Centre and Home, London, EC1M 6HA Contract type: Permanent Business area: Sainsbury's Financial Services Ltd Closing date: 24 August 2026 Requisition ID: 400076067

We’d all like amazing work to do, and real work-life balance. That’s waiting for you here at Sainsbury’s. For a FTSE business, we move incredibly fast. When we’re not leading projects, we’re supporting teams across the wider group to achieve their goals. And here, you can see the impact of your work as soon as you walk into a store, giving you a real sense of purpose and responsibility. Better still, the team around you will listen to your ideas and opinions, and you’ll have every chance to try something new. The scale and complexity of our business mean there’s always something new to learn, and we’ll support you every step of the way. We’re trusted to get on with it. So get ready to make things happen.

**Location:**London or Edinburgh Store Support Centre & Home. Colleagues go into the office 1-2 days per week on average.

**Why join us**

Joining the Finance team at Sainsbury's Financial Services offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of financial services within a multi-channel retail environment. Sainsbury’s Financial Services is at the start of its journey, and this role will help shape the long-term growth; you will play a crucial role in managing complex data sets and driving strategic financial planning initiatives, supporting business growth, challenging the status quo, and delivering valuable insights to drive decision-making.

With a focus on collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement, you will have the chance to make a significant impact on the performance and direction of Sainsbury's Financial Services division, while benefiting from a supportive work environment and opportunities for personal and professional development.

**What you'll do**

As a Commercial Finance Manager, you will play a crucial role as the primary interface between Finance and business owners for Sainsbury's Financial Services products. Your responsibilities will include providing support and challenge to ensure the preparation of reliable and timely financial plans, driving income generation and cost-saving initiatives, and conducting financial analysis for business cases and ad hoc insight. You will represent finance at product review meetings, present financial performance and analysis, co-ordinate and process information for the annual planning cycle, and develop models to measure the impact of changes on budgeted balance sheets and P & L positions.

Additionally, you will utilise large data sets to optimise product profitability, support requests for ad hoc analytics, and deputise for the Head of Finance in key committees to discuss overall financial performance within the Financial Services division. Your role will be instrumental in contributing to the strategic financial planning and decision-making processes within the organisation.

**Who you are**

You are a highly skilled professional with a proven track record of delivering value through insightful analysis and financial expertise. Your ability to challenge and collaborate with stakeholders in a constructive manner, coupled with your proficiency in building complex financial models and working with large data sets, enables you to drive informed decision-making and optimise product profitability. With strong communication skills and strategic thinking, you effectively translate complex finance and data analytics into actionable insights, supporting the business in achieving its financial goals and objectives.

**Essential Criteria**

* Qualified accountant (e.g. ACA, ACCA, CIMA) or demonstrable experience operating as a Commercial Finance Manager with accountability for financial analysis and decision support
* Proven ability to build, maintain and enhance complex financial models using Microsoft Office applications, including advanced Excel
* Demonstrable experience analysing large and complex datasets to identify trends, solve business problems and support decision-making; Power BI and SQL experience is desirable
* Evidence of delivering measurable business value through financial analysis, insight generation and recommendations
* Proven ability to communicate complex financial, data and analytical information to senior stakeholders, including providing constructive challenge and influencing business decisions

#LI-CE1

We are committed to being a truly inclusive retailer so you’ll be welcomed whoever you are and wherever you work. Around here, there’s always the chance to try something new — whether that’s as part of an evolving team or somewhere else across the business - and we take development seriously and promise to support you. We also recognise and celebrate colleagues when they go the extra mile and, where possible, offer flexible working. When you join our team, we’ll also offer you an amazing range of benefits. Here are some of them:

Starting off with colleague discount, you'll be able to save 10% on your shopping online and instore at Sainsbury's, Argos, TU and Habitat, and we regularly increase the discount to 15% at points during the year. We've also got you covered for your future with our pensions scheme and life cover. You'll also be able to share in our success as you may be eligible for a performance-related bonus of up to 20% of salary, depending on how we perform.

Your wellbeing is important to us too. You'll receive an annual holiday allowance, and you can buy up to an additional week's holiday, and we provide private healthcare. We also offer other benefits that will help your money go further such as season ticket loans, interest free car loan of up to £10k, cycle to work scheme, health cash plans, salary advance (where you can access some of your pay before pay day) as well access to a great range of discounts from hundreds of other retailers. And if you ever need it there is also an Employee Assistance Programme.

Moments that matter are as important to us as they are to you which is why we give up to 26 weeks’ pay for maternity or adoption leave and up to 4 weeks’ pay for paternity leave.

Please see www.sainsburys.jobs for a range of our benefits (note, length of service and eligibility criteria may apply).

The team is part of SCOR's P&C Operations organization and acts as a central function supporting global P&C business processes.

***Job Summary***
- As a Lead Reporting Analyst, you will take ownership of the end-to-end delivery of complex reporting solutions, shaping requirements with stakeholders, challenging and refining business needs, and ensuring alignment with strategic priorities, growth objectives, sustainability commitments and regulatory obligations.
- You will act as a bridge between business stakeholders, development teams, data engineers and external resources, providing clear direction on priorities, design, implementation and launch. Leveraging tools such as Power BI, Palantir, Excel, SQL and other SCOR-approved technologies, you will help define scalable reporting solutions while ensuring data quality, consistency and reliability.
- Beyond project delivery, you will provide oversight of business-as-usual reporting activities, ensuring operational resilience, service continuity and continuous improvement across tactical and strategic reporting platforms such as SSMS, Excel and Power BI.
- Contribute a business perspective where new technologies could advance SCOR's analytical advantage, including but not limited to Palantir, Azure Databricks, Spark, and the use, integration or build of AI models.
- Be an active contributor in identifying new ways and techniques to help business teams better understand data, including conceptual data models, data quality monitoring, completeness checks and base business requirements.
- Act as a key contributor in designing and developing frameworks and standards that promote good data hygiene, create a consistent way of interacting with platforms, and establish a continually improving methodology to elicit end-to-end user interactions and use cases.
- This role also involves coaching and mentoring junior team members, promoting best practices in reporting and data analysis, delivering targeted training on data assets and Power BI, and building trusted relationships with SCOR stakeholders. You will support regulatory reporting deadlines, assess and document change requirements, and guide implementation through development clarifications, testing and UAT cycles.

## Responsibilities

***Key duties and responsibilities***

**Core Responsibilities**
- Lead the definition and analysis of complex reporting requirements, proactively challenging assumptions, aligning expectations with stakeholders, and ensuring consistency with business strategy, regulatory standards and data governance principles.
- Shape and validate reporting prototypes in collaboration with data engineers, ensuring proposed solutions are scalable, maintainable and aligned with stakeholder expectations and target reporting architecture.
- Act as a liaison between stakeholders, development teams and external resources, providing direction, removing ambiguity, managing expectations and ensuring effective coordination across the project lifecycle.
- Own the testing and UAT approach for reporting deliverables, ensuring accuracy, reliability, traceability and timely sign-off from relevant stakeholders.
- Ensure reporting solutions are handed over with clear documentation, training and operating guidance, enabling sustainable adoption and effective ongoing ownership by business users and support teams.

**Data Quality Management**
- Establish and identify data quality concerns and issues, working with P&C Operations to ensure the appropriate level of monitoring is performed.
- Participate in ongoing data quality reviews and audits to ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
- Support the continuous improvement to enhance, improve and streamline data management processes.

**Regulatory and External Collaboration**
- Lead collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to deliver regulatory reporting requirements, ensuring robust planning, clear accountability and consistent achievement of regulatory deadlines.
- Provide analytical support for statutory and regulatory reporting initiatives, maintaining strong controls, compliance discipline and quality standards.
- In collaboration with Data Engineers, lead the build, testing and implementation of regulatory reporting solutions.
- Guide stakeholders through validation, sign-off and submission of regulatory returns.

**Technical Development and Support**
- Provide technical and functional leadership to Analysts, Data & Analytics Developers, Data Engineers and business users in the specification and development of reports, data extracts, dashboards and analytical outputs.
- Apply advanced knowledge of reporting tools and data technologies, including Excel, Power BI and SQL, to consolidate, cleanse, transform, reconcile and present data from multiple sources.
- Lead the resolution of data quality, reconciliation and completeness issues, driving root-cause analysis and sustainable improvements to ensure accurate, timely and trusted information across the organization.

- Provide oversight of existing reporting processes, ensuring reliability, accuracy, operational resilience and timely delivery of business-critical outputs.

The TTS Inventory & Planning Specialist (UK) owns inventory operations and assortment planning for SharkNinja's TikTok Shop business. Partnering closely with the DTC Inventory & Planning Manager, Ops and category owners, the role keeps the channel stocked against the forecast, spotting out-of-stock risk early and pivoting into viable alternatives, while shaping the range through gap analysis, TTS exclusives and bigger bets on the products with the most upside. It is a strategic seat rather than a transactional one: building demand scenarios and bet cases that steer buy and phasing decisions, informing the revenue and SKU-level assumptions behind the forecast, and pressure-testing the plan through both a supply lens and a commercial one to protect GM% and ASP.  

**What you will do:**

* Own TTS inventory operations end to end, driven by the forecast, live demand and commercial bets, spotting out-of-stock risk ahead of time and pivoting into a viable alternative before sales are lost.

* Pressure-test the forecast through a supply lens, avoiding supply risk and pivoting into alternative opportunities, and pressure-test GM% and ASP to protect a healthy channel P&L.

* Partner with Ops teams, ingesting allocation and stock transfer information and then ensuring the channel has the inventory required to achieve the forecast, keeping DTC/TTS splits aligned and closing gaps with category owners. * Identify excess and obsolete stock early and support with building the plan to leverage it (bundling, live-event features, pricing or promotional mechanics), clearing ageing units through the channel while protecting margin.

* Plan launch volumes for new product introductions: sizing the launch quantity required, phasing stock to the launch strategy and making sure the channel is covered through the critical first weeks of sell-through.

* Shape the TikTok Shop assortment strategy: identify range gaps, build the case for TTS exclusives and place bigger bets on the products with the most upside, then review whether those bets paid back and feed the learnings into the next round.

* Build demand scenarios and bet cases that steer range, buy and phasing decisions, and inform the tops-down forecast target, including revenue and SKU-level assumptions and what the channel needs to comp.

* Ensure the channel has inventory to scale live commerce: building stock ahead of major live events and peak trading, modelling upside scenarios and making sure availability never caps a breakout moment.

* Establish clear and consistent planning cadences across the cross-functional group (weekly trade, monthly forecast reviews and range checkpoints) so inputs land on time and decisions are made against a shared view.

* Leverage internal tools, such as PBI, and AI technology, to provide regular reporting including data visualisation on stock volumes, risk, and opportunities.

**What you will have:**

* Experience in sales analysis, demand planning, category management or financial analysis.

* Exposure to a fast-moving e-commerce, marketplace or DTC channel, where demand is volatile, promotional and event-driven rather than steady-state.

* Working knowledge of inventory planning mechanics (stock cover, allocation, phasing, launch sizing and out-of-stock mitigation), and comfort partnering with supply chain or operations teams.

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

* Ability to build scenario and sensitivity models: sizing upside and downside cases and translating them into a buy or phasing recommendation.

* Strong experience working with pivot tables, large data sets and data visualisation. Ability to translate complex data into clear, concise business insights.

* Fluency with BI and AI tools: Power BI or equivalent for reporting, and a habit of using AI to speed up analysis rather than waiting for someone else to build it.

* Commercial judgement: able to read a P&L, understand the levers behind GM% and ASP, and make a case for a bet rather than only reporting the numbers.

* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

* Proven ability to influence without authority: holding a cross-functional group to a planning cadence, closing gaps with category owners and making the case for a bet to commercial and finance stakeholders.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

**Meet Sievo**

We are Sievo – the leading procurement analytics SaaS company from Finland. We help the largest companies in the world, household brands like Levi’s, Kellogg’s and Mars, to generate cost savings, understand their procurement data, make data-driven decisions, reduce emissions, drive supply chain resilience, and beyond. Each year, we process spend equivalent to 2% of the global GDP. Pretty cool, right?

Our core values are caring, exceeding, and honesty - values that make us grow bigger and better, not bigger and bitter.

**The role**

The Product Director of Data Products is responsible for making Community Data a success. What is Community Data? When 2% of global GDP runs through Sievo, patterns emerge that no single company could see on its own. Community Data is Sievo's aggregated, anonymized view across all of it – benchmarks, data management, supplier intelligence, and spend patterns from a dataset representing a significant slice of global corporate purchasing.

This role defines the future of our data's value and the solutions built on it, for our SaaS customers and beyond: from the customer problem to data governance and contribution incentives, to credibility, to pricing and packaging Community Data, to defending it as a durable moat. You will be reporting directly to the SVP Product.

This is one of the hardest problems at Sievo- and one of the most valuable.

**What you'll be doing**

* Define what Community Data continues to become as a product – from the vision to the concrete product roadmap.
* Design what and how customers contribute data and why they'd want to, balancing what they give up against what they get back.
* Continue establishing the methodology and statistical credibility that make benchmarks and intelligence trustworthy enough to act on.
* Own pricing and packaging: decide what's sold as a distinct data product versus bundled into the core SaaS platform.
* Partner with sales and marketing to build the commercial motion and prove customers will pay.
* Lead the team alongside an Engineering Manager, setting vision and strategy and guiding the team in the right direction, while they own delivery.
* Represent Community Data at the leadership level as a strategic asset and moat, not a feature line.

**To succeed in this role, you:**

* Have experience in (ideally B2B) SaaS and/or data products product management.
* Have personally built and packaged a data or benchmarking product from an ambiguous starting point.
* Have made real pricing and monetization decisions and can speak concretely to what worked and what didn't.
* Proven ability to set vision and strategy autonomously, and to lead a team without a continuously pre-defined roadmap to fall back on.
* Excellent communication skills in English; can translate a genuinely ambiguous, technical problem into a clear narrative for engineers, sales, and the CEO alike.
* Strong analytical and statistical reasoning: comfortable with sample size, bias, and methodology questions, without needing to write the code or run the analysis yourself (that’s why you have a team).
* AI is part of how you work, not just to move faster but to do things that weren't possible before.
* Ambitious, outcome-driven, genuinely energized by an undefined problem rather than needing one handed to you.

**What awaits you at Sievo**

* A senior, high-impact Product Director role owning one of Sievo’s most strategic product opportunities end-to-end, helping define Sievo’s overall product strategy and commercial growth with a direct line to the executive team.
* Real ownership to define the future of Community Data as a product, from vision and roadmap to methodology, governance, pricing, packaging, and go-to-market impact.
* Sievonians are ambitious, yet kind and supportive -you’ll work with an international team of 40+ nationalities, collaborating with smart, driven, and genuinely kind people.
* Our Finnish roots run deep: we are founded on an open, honest and transparent Nordic working culture where we value freedom and responsibility, while working with high standards. We’re looking for an engineer to join the team behind Postcard — the platform that runs Smaller Earth Group’s cultural exchange programmes. It’s the software that takes a young person from “I think I want to work a summer abroad” all the way to standing in front of a cabin of kids in Maine, or a chalet in the Alps, having the time of their life.

You’d be joining a small, internal product team. “Small” means your work carries real weight — what you ship genuinely moves the business, and there’s nowhere for good (or bad) decisions to hide. “Internal product team” means you’re close to the people who actually use Postcard every day, and close to the participants and employers on the other end of it. No ticket factories, no three sprints of refinement before anyone writes a line of code. Just real problems — applications, payments, matching the right person to the right placement — and the satisfaction of solving them properly.

Postcard runs the core of a global business. So there’s the usual tension we find genuinely fun: keep a mature platform stable and trustworthy, while moving fast enough to build the things that’ll carry it forward.

## The stack

Ruby on Rails 8 and MySQL doing the heavy lifting, with a mix of legacy JavaScript and Hotwire (Turbo + Stimulus) on the front end. Background work on Sidekiq, payments on Stripe, deployments via Capistrano and tests in RSpec. We also have two user-facing portals written in React which interface with Postcard over an API.

## This role is ideal if you

* Have extensive experience building and scaling web platforms with Ruby on Rails and/or React, and genuine enthusiasm for the framework
* Are happy working across the full stack
* Have an eye for good UI/UX — you sweat the details users feel but never mention: empty states, sensible defaults, error messages that actually help
* Can point to projects you’ve driven to completion, keeping one eye on scalability the whole way
* Value lean development — you take pride in shipping quickly without trading away quality
* Like the idea of working AI-first, but staying fully accountable for everything you ship
* Want to help foster a culture of psychological safety, inclusivity, and continuous improvement

You don’t need to know anything about summer camps or cultural exchange. (Fair warning, though: you’ll absorb a worrying amount of knowledge about placement matching and visa processes either way.)

This role is also open to newcomers to Rails and React — if our stack isn’t the one you’ve worked in, but you can point to solid, proven experience building real things in other frameworks, we’d still love to hear from you. Good engineers pick up Rails fast, and we’re happy to help you do it.

## The hiring process

Our process has a few stages:

1. **An introductory call with our CTO (Ross).** This is mostly to introduce Smaller Earth Group, the technology team, and the role. Ross will walk you through the rest of the process and answer any immediate questions.
2. **A remote technical interview** (with Ross and another member of the tech team). Beforehand, you’ll be given a small challenge to work through (roughly 1–2 hours). We’ll spend most of the interview discussing your approach and digging into a few areas together — it’s much less about a “right answer” and more about how you think through problems and tackle them.
3. **An offer!**

* **Pension** — 5% employee and 3% employer contributions (5% from October 2026)
* **Location** — most of the product team work remotely. We’re headquartered in Liverpool and meet there in person occasionally (~twice a year) — good coffee, decent views, mild peer pressure to talk product for lunch. Remote or in the office, we require a right to work in the UK
* **Mental health support** — free same-day therapist support for all employees via Spill

## Why Smaller Earth Group

* As of 2024, we’re an Employee Ownership Trust (EOT) — the company is owned by the people who work in it, including (if you join) you
* Modern office space on the iconic Docks in Liverpool city centre, with scenic views and dangerous proximity to good lunch spots
* Work-life balance: flexible arrangements, whether that’s remote or our relaxed workspace at Avenue HQ in Liverpool

* Perform independent assessments of the overall accuracy, effectiveness, and reliability of the balance sheet interest rate risk management framework.
* Participate in special projects and review business strategies and new business initiatives to ensure business objectives are met within the firm’s overall risk appetite.
* Review, challenge and report the firm's balance sheet interest rate risk profile and changes timely and accurately.
* Develop interest rate risk limits, policy, guidelines and operating procedures, according to regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a **$75 million Series B -** led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

We’re looking for **Staff Engineers** to accelerate product delivery and enable scale across our customer acquisition, customer success and developer experience platforms. You’ll contribute through hands-on coding, drive architectural direction, and raise the technical bar across the team.

In your first 12 months, you’ll lead the development of systems that redefine how brokers, customers, and internal teams interact with energy services - from real-time pricing workflows to intuitive self-serve tools. You’ll help us launch new products that streamline onboarding, improve service transparency, and lay the groundwork for rapid, sustainable growth.

* **Build with impact:** Architect and deliver end-to-end systems, from internal automation to customer-facing portals, ensuring they are scalable, fast, and user-friendly.
* **Own the platform:** Improve and extend core platforms and developer tooling, making it easier for teams to build, test, and ship quality software.
* **Drive innovation:** Rapidly prototype and iterate on new workflows and product ideas that expand our offering and improve the broker and customer journey.
* **Partner cross-functionally:** Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineers to scope, design, and deliver high-impact solutions.
* **Raise the bar:** Lead by example through code reviews, mentorship, and championing engineering best practices across the team.

# 🎯 Requirements:

**Must-Haves:**

* **Track record in fast-paced environments:** Experience as a Senior or Staff Engineer in a high-growth startup or scale-up, with a strong bias toward shipping.
* **System design at scale:** Proven ability to design and build complex systems that power both back-end automation and front-end experiences.
* **Modern tech expertise:** Deep experience with Python, Node.js, and AWS serverless architecture (e.g., Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB).
* **Front-end capabilities:** Skilled in developing responsive, performant front-ends using modern JavaScript frameworks such as React.
* **Product-minded mindset:** Experience working closely with product and design teams to solve user problems, not just deliver features.
* **Can deal with ambiguity:** Comfortable navigating changing priorities and incomplete information to make strong technical decisions.

**Desirable:**

* Exposure to the energy sector or other regulated industries.
* Experience building internal tools or platforms for brokers, sales teams, or support agents.
* Familiarity with real-time data processing or agentic/AI-driven systems.

* **Competitive salar**y - our current band for this role is £104,000 or equivalent in local currency.

  + We pay against a clear benchmark for your role and level. No fixed once- or twice-a-year cycle - pay moves when the evidence for it does.
* **Stock Options** - everyone on the team has ownership in our mission.
* **25 days holiday + public holidays** - Swap public holidays for ones that matter most to you. Plus, get an extra day off for your birthday 🎉.
* **Remote & flexible working** - We’re fully remote with clear core hours, and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.
* **Home working & wellbeing budgets**:

  + Up to **£1,200 / €1,200 annually** to upgrade your remote setup (co-working passes, equipment, etc.).
  + Up to **£150 / €150 monthly** on anything that supports your wellbeing - from therapy to gym memberships to meditation apps.

# 🗣️ Interview Process:

Our processes normally take around 2-3 weeks from first call to offer - please let us know about any adjustments to timelines that may be required.

1. **First call with our Talent Team (30 Mins).** This is to understand your experience, motivations, and discuss the role in more detail.
2. **Behaviour Interview with our Engineering Managers (60 Mins).** This is your chance to really understand the role, the expectations, and ensure alignment on ways of working.
3. **Technical Interview with the Team (75 Mins)**. You’ll meet with potential peers in this session and will discuss technical topics and experiences.
4. **Culture-Add Interview with Stakeholders (45 Mins).** The final session will be with two cross-functional stakeholders, and will explore how your values align with ours, and is designed to be a genuine two-way conversation, your chance to understand what it’s really like to work at tem.

If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.*
